English: After floods, disinfect homes to prevent mold and diseases. Wear protective gear during cleanup.
Ekegusii: Nyuma yetoigo, siarera omochie ariogo riogoita abinyinyi gotanga amatosi namarwaire. Beka chianga chiogwetanga gotonyerwa neriogo.

English: During prolonged disasters, preserve food by drying, salting, or using airtight containers to avoid spoilage.
Ekegusii: Ekero kiechando emetambe buna omogaso gose embura enyinge, gacha endagera ase okoyiomia, koyebeka omonyo, goge koyesiba ime yebibekerero embeo etari gosoa ime koyerenda tegunda.

English: Rumors worsen panic. Rely on official updates from government agencies and verified media outlets.
Ekegusii: Amangana oborimo nigo akogesa obororo. Nyora amangana korwa aase aronge buna eserikari amo nabariki na abamanyi amangana bokwegenwa.

English: Snakes seek shelter in homes during floods. Use torches at night and avoid walking barefoot.
Ekegusii: Chingiti ching'enda'nse origia chire obomenyo chinka chiaito ekero chietoigo. Tumia etochi botuko na erende gotatacha inse namagoro amasa aotabegeti ebiato.

English: Insurance mitigates financial losses from floods, fires, or storms. Explore affordable micro-insurance options.
Ekegusii: Chinsuarensi nigo chigotanga babanto konyora asara ekero kiembura enyinge nemegoko, emerero, gose emerindo. Rigia komanya ebiombe ebike bikorwa ogokonya ekero kiemebasekano yoboremi bwao ekobe ase rigori rianse.

English: Vulnerable families can access government cash aid during disasters via mobile money platforms.
Ekegusii: Chifamiri chiria chitari kwenyara gose chintaka mbwango konyorwa nemechando, tema goikera ogokonya gweserikari goetera omoroberio (o'cash aid) ekero kiemechando goetera esimi yao.

English: Avoid rebuilding in landslide-prone areas. Government offers alternative land for affected families.
Ekegusii: Tiga koirorera kwoagacha ase riroba rikoanyoka. Eserikari nkorwa ere emegondo emao ase oyio oo ase chifamilia chianyorirwe nomochando oyio.

English: Free fire safety training is available for communities to prevent and respond to fire outbreaks.
Ekegusii: Amasomo abosa igoro yokwerenda ekero kiomorero nareo ase ebinyoro gotanga nagokonya chingaki omorero ogwateka.

English: Water conducts electricity. Avoid touching power lines or electrical appliances during floods.
Ekegusii: Chinguru chiomorero bwesitima ngoeta chire ase amache. Tiga kobwata ebitanke biesitima gose ebinto biesitima chingaki chietoigo gose amache ateremete.

English: Farmers should adopt drought-resistant crops and water conservation techniques to mitigate climate shocks.
Ekegusii: Nere buya ase abaremi gosimeka ebimeri bikoremereria omogaso omnene amo nenchera yokogacha na gotumia buya amache na gotanga konyorwa gose gokeania konyorwa nemechando eyio .

English: Learn to build temporary shelters using locally available materials for displaced families.
Ekegusii: Egera koacha chinyomba ogtumia ebinto bigotoka inka ase bari baseretigwe korwa aase bare abwo nyuma.

English: Stampedes worsen disasters. Follow authorities' instructions and avoid panic during mass evacuations.
Ekegusii: Ekere omobasekano obeire ekero abanto bakomigererania gotama nogo gokogesa emechando ende emenene. Bwatia ekere abarai bagoteba gokonya okomagamaga chingaki chiogokonya kwabanto abange.

English: Learn to recognize trauma symptoms and provide psychological first aid to disaster survivors.
Ekegusii: Tema komanya buna obwoba gose ogwechanda kwa abanto banyorirwe nomobasekano erio kobakonya korwania obwoba obwo goetera obosemia bwebirengererio na kobasira nchera ende yonsi erio banyare gotenenana kogenderera.

English: Ensure LPG cylinders are stored in well-ventilated areas and check for leaks regularly.
Ekegusii: Rora ng'a omotungi bwegasi yokorugera mbuya egachiire na aase agiya are nerigaba riembeo gosoa ime, na rigereria kera chingaki komanya gose egasi nkominchoria ere korwa omotungi oyesokie bwango buna enchera eyemo yogotanga emebasekano.

English: Older adults need tailored evacuation plans. Identify caregivers and accessible shelters in advance.
Ekegusii: Abanto abagotu mbaganetie enchera yabeene kobatamia korwa emebasekano. Beka abatenereri babo amo nase oraibaire kobera motwe yokobatania korwa omobasekano.

English: Village loudspeakers, SMS alerts, and radio broadcasts help disseminate disaster warnings quickly.
Ekegusii: Beka amakondo komanyia abanto, tima amangana amenge goetera esimi, nechiredi gokonya komanyia abanto ase oboagare nogokurerwa bwango igoro yomobasekano.

English: Chemicals and fuels should be stored away from homes to prevent fires and environmental contamination.
Ekegusii: Chikemiko naguta nere buya kogachwa are korwa chinka na ase engencho ebwenerete eri ogotanga ogwateka kwemerero na ogosaria amasingira.

English: Lost family members can be traced through Kenya Red Cross and social media platforms.
Ekegusii: Abanto basirete nnabo barabwatigwe goetera ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) amo nabariki amangana na komanyia abanto amang'ana.

English: Stagnant water breeds mosquitoes. Use bed nets and report mosquito infestations to health authorities.
Ekegusii: Chiumbu nigo chikoiborerana ase amache atereime. Tumia chineti chiebitanda korara na manyia abanyagitari igoro yokoromwa nechiumbu na buna abanto barwarete.

English: Communities should invest in boreholes and rainwater harvesting to ensure water access during droughts.
Ekegusii: Nere buya ebinyoro kobeka chinguri chiabo ase okorema ebisima ebinene bia abanto abange nomoroberion bwogotacha amache erio koba namache aisaine chingaki chieguragura.

English: Kenya's policy framework ensures coordinated disaster management. Understand your rights and government obligations.
Ekegusii: Amachiko aKenya igoro yobokoreri ekero kia omobasekano nkoenekia are ng'a okobeaterana nekomoti yemebasekano. Manya aboronge bwao neki eserikari ebwenerete kogokorera.

English: The national helpline 1195 is available at all times to provide immediate assistance to survivors of sexual and gender-based violence.
Ekegusii: Enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195 inao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi koreng'ana na eki ore.

English: Intimate partner violence often escalates gradually. Early recognition and training for frontline professionals support prevention and safe referrals.
Ekegusii: Eminano gose ogokurarana gati yomosacha nomokungu oye mara aanga nigo gokogenderera kogesekana na koba boke ng'orang'ora. Mbuya komanya ayio bwango na kwegeria abakoreri baria bare motwe gokonya ase okobaikera na kobakonya ebirengererio na kobaraa gochia nyagitari ase kobwenigwa.

English: Prompt reporting of gender-based violence protects survivors and preserves evidence. Specialized Gender Desks handle cases sensitively and survivors have rights to medical care, protection, and legal support.
Ekegusii: Komanyia ase obwango amang'ana eminano gose ogokorerwa bobe egekogera eki ore ngokonya kore baria bakoreirwe bobe, na gacha obosaidi igoro yayio. Egetengo kia beene ase Chinyagitari na Porisi nao amangana ogokorerwa bobe ase engencho yeki ore agokonyerwa, na baria bakoreirwe bobe mbare noboronge bwabo konyora obobwenia, korenda kemachiko na gokonya kemachiko.

English: All public health facilities in Kenya offer free medical services for gender-based violence survivors.
Ekegusii: Chinyagitari chionsi chieserikari aiga nka Kenya nkorwa chire obobwenia ao ao bogokorerwa bobe bosa ase baria bamocheirwe.

English: Personal safety plans help individuals prepare for dangerous situations by identifying safe locations and strategies for protection.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio oo aye omonyene kwerenda ngokonya ore kwebanga chingaki chiokong'u ase okomanya boronge ase ogotamera gochia na buna okwerenda.

English: Community support networks assist survivors by providing safe spaces, trained volunteers, empowerment programs, and coordinated referrals while prioritizing safety and confidentiality.
Ekegusii: Ebokundi biogosira ase ebinyoro nigo bigokonya baria bakoreirwe bobe ase enchera yokobaa aase bakobera atari namochando onde bwonsi goetera abakonyi babo bokwerwa begeirie buya, kobasira goetera ebinto bike bike bikobakonya, na kobwaterana gochia ase baranyare konyora obokonyi ao ao, oborendi bwaigoro nobobisi bwabo.

English: Workplace policies and training prevent sexual harassment by establishing clear definitions, reporting channels, investigations, and support services based on national legal frameworks.
Ekegusii: Koba namachiko ase abanto bagokora emeremo na kobaegeria igor yoboronge bwa mwanyabanto ngokonya ere gokorerwa bobe kebwanchani egekogera kera omokori emeremo amanyete buya nga ogokora eke gose keria aya naria naro aramonyore, chinchera omonto akomanyeria abane igoro yayio, obotuki, amo nemeroberio yokomosira korengna nerichiko riense.

English: Child protection systems must prevent sexual abuse and exploitation and provide full support for affected children.
Ekegusii: Nebwenerete nga ebitengo bionsi bire bikorenda abana gtanga na abana gotibonwa na bosomba bonde bwonsi goetera okobaa ogokonya gwa kera engencho.

English: Healthcare workers require specialized training in trauma-informed care, evidence collection, mandatory reporting, and coordinated referrals for survivors.
Ekegusii: Abakori emeremo bobochenu mbaganeirie amaorokererio abeene ase ogokonya barwaire babo komanya emechando nagekong'ia koyerwania, kobeka amo obosaiti , kobeka eripoti as ebitabu, na na okobwatera kobatoma gochia baranyore obokonyi bwa beene.

English: Safe houses and shelters offer secure temporary accommodation for survivors and their children.
Ekegusii: Aase agiya neyomba yokomenya nensemo eyemo yoborendi ase baria bakoreirwe bobe nabana babo.

English: Digital spaces can expose individuals to online abuse. Laws criminalize cyberviolence and support services help survivors secure devices, report incidents, and remove harmful content.
Ekegusii: Goetera obokonyi bwedichitari nkonyarekana ere gosioria baria bagokorera bobe abande goetera eintaneti. Amachiko nkorenda are abanto tobakorerwa bobe goetera eintaneti na kobakonya korenda chisimi nechikombiuta chiabo neintaneti korwa ebibago, korwa eripoti yokogoserwa, na gotinyia amangana aria akogechia.

English: Engaging men and boys in prevention programs promotes healthy relationships and challenges harmful gender norms.
Ekegusii: Renta abasacha nabura amo ase emeroberio yogosegeta oboamate obuya ase abanto na orokereria buna ogotareng'anana kwa banto ase engencho yebimira ere bobe.

English: Legal aid services ensure survivors access justice through free or subsidized representation.
Ekegusii: Ogokonya abanto kemachiko nigo korengete korora nga goikera ekeene goeera gokonywa bosa otari korwa kende gose ogoaka pesa inke igo omogambi bwebina gokogambera kotini.

English: Educational institutions must implement prevention programs that address harassment, assault, and exploitation in learning environments.
Ekegusii: Chisukuru razima chiikeranie emeroberio gotanga gokorerwa bobe kobasuguma gose kobagechi, kobarwania ngose komiga oboronge bwabo ase engencho bare abagongeru ase chisukuru.

English: Economic abuse limits financial independence. Financial institutions should recognize warning signs and support affected customers.
Ekegusii: Obosaria bwobogoko nigo bokomiga okwenyara nogwetenenera gwechibesa. Ebiombe baria bionsi bigokora nechibesa nere buya asebire komanya bwango emechando ere motwe na buna baranyare gokonya baria bakogachera chibesa chiabo.

English: Human trafficking for sexual exploitation is a serious crime. National laws provide strong penalties and survivor protections.
Ekegusii: Enchera yokobetereria gose koira abanto ase egete ase engencho yokobaonia ase ebiasara biobwanchani konyora chibesa okomocha okobe mono. Amachiko yense nkorwa are egesusuro ekerito na gokonya baria bakoreirwe bobe.

English: Risk assessment tools help identify individuals at high risk of experiencing or perpetrating violence to enable targeted interventions.
Ekegusii: Amasakara abwate amaborio na buna abanto bakoiraneria ebigokonya korora na komanya buna abanto baria bare ase ekonyarekana gokorerwa bobe gose kogenderera gokorerwa bobe erio gokonya kobeka emeroberio yogotanga ebwenerete.

English: Survivor-centered approaches uphold safety, dignity, and autonomy in all decisions about reporting and service use.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio yokobakonya baria bakoreirwe bobe nigo ekoimokereria igoro oborendi, amasikani, obobisi, nobosibore bwomonto korwa ebirengerio biaye neko aganeti gokorerwa.

English: Emergency settings heighten gender-based violence risks and require specialized prevention and response planning.
Ekegusii: Chingaki chiemebasekano gose obokongu nigo chikogesa ribaga abanto gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki bare naya ekero abeire neganeirie chinchera chigotanga abanto gokorerwa bobe chaiabeene na emeroberio buna baranyare gokonywa.

English: Reliable data systems track violence trends and service use to inform evidence-based policies and programs.
Ekegusii: Amangana aria arikire amaikeranu buna chiripoti chiabasikari, chianyagitari na NGOs chikworokia buna abanto bagokorerwa bobe erio gokonya korosia amachiko nemeroberio yokobakonya.

English: Strategic communication campaigns promote non-violent norms and responsible media coverage of gender-based violence.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwoboamo obangire buya komanyia na gosomia abanto korengete gosegeta abanto goonchoreria na kwanga gokorera abanto bande bobe na korwa eripoti igoro ya baria bakoreirwe bobe otarikonyorwa, amo noboriki na komanyia abanto amang'ana goetera chiredio na amagaseti ase enchewra etari koeneria gokwanrera obobe bwogokorera aband bobe.

English: Persons with disabilities face higher risks of violence. Services must meet accessibility needs and provide inclusive support.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaremaru nigo bagokorerwa bobe kobua abanto bande. Ogokonywa kobarengete goika goikeranie buna bagoikerwa nokogania kwabo ase bonsi.

English: Refugee and displaced populations require protection measures and community involvement to reduce violence risks.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria abatemete chisegi korwa sobo na baria baseretigwe korwa ase abrenge ase chisegi chigesiasa nobogekaku mbaganetie chinhera buna bakorendwa ase okobwaterana nebinyoro gokeania gokorerwa bobe.

English: Correctional facilities must prevent sexual violence and respond effectively to any incidents.
Ekegusii: Chichera goika chitange ogokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki oro na korwa egusuro korengana nokomocha kwabamochi.

English: Technology-facilitated abuse requires digital security training and documentation skills for affected individuals.
Ekegusii: Ogokorerwa bobe goetra eintaneti neganetie oborendi bwegedichitari goetera ogosomia nenchera engiya yokorika na kogacha amang'ana ase bari bakoreire bobe.

English: Community-based prevention programs mobilize local leaders and groups to create safer environments.
Ekegusii: Oborendi goetera emeroberio yebinyoro goetra okoreta abarai nebiombe amo korora nga abanto bonsi mbuya bare kera ase bare.

English: Institutions must coordinate across sectors to provide effective, compassionate responses to survivors.
Ekegusii: Chinsemo chiserikari ao ao goika kobwaterana korwa obokonyi obuya nobwanchani ase abakoreirwe bobe.

English: Research strengthens program design and policy by generating evidence on effective prevention and response strategies.
Ekegusii: Amasomo okorigia chisemi chinyia, kobanga emeroberio na korosia amachiko goetera obomanyi obwo koba nechinguru gotanga gokorerwa bobe.

English: Women in politics face violence aimed at limiting participation. Electoral laws protect candidates and voters from gender-based harm.
Ekegusii: Obakungu bagokora siasa nigo bagokorerwa bobe korengete gokeania esiasa yabo gochia ase abasqacha. Amachiko obochori nkorenda are abarigia chikura nabaaki chikura korwa gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki bare.

English: Healthcare facilities must screen for violence and provide safe and comprehensive responses for survivors.
Ekegusii: Ase abanto bakobwenerigwa goikbapime ekerengo omonto okoreire bobe na korwa obobwenia boisaine naende obuya.

English: Public transport systems must address harassment through staff training and appropriate response measures.
Ekegusii: Abarai bechirori chikobogori abanto goika chitange ebikoru biokogosereria goetera ogosomia bakori emeremo babo na korwa egesusuro ase abamochi.

English: Women in agriculture face distinct risks. Cooperatives should adopt prevention policies and reporting options.
Ekegusii: Abakungu bagokora emeremo ase oboremi nigo bare ase okonyorwa nemechando yabeene. Ebiombe bioboremi nere buya bitabe amachiko yogotanga nenchera yokorwa chiripoti.

English: High-density informal settlements require community-led safety efforts to reduce violence.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete chirandi mabaganetie okobwaterana newbinyoro erio gokeania chiburaburu.

English: Older women experience specific forms of abuse. Caregiver training supports prevention and protection.
Ekegusii: Abangina abagotu nigo bagokorerwa bobe enchera ching'ao. Egeria baria babarendete buna enchera eyemo yogotanga gokorerwa bobe na kobarenda.

English: Religious institutions influence community norms. Clergy training and counseling support safe and equitable environments.
Ekegusii: Chidini ngosegeta chire buna ebinyoro bikorosia amachiko ekemira. Gosomia barai bechidini nigo egokonya gosegeta ababwatai babo korenda amasingira.

English: Sports programs must prevent harassment, abuse, and hazing through clear boundaries and reporting procedures.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio yechigori goika ekonye gotanga ebikoru bikogosereri agose bikogechi, gose bikorasimisa omonto gosoa na chinchera chiokoripoti ayio.

English: Hospitality venues should recognize and address risks such as trafficking and harassment while protecting guests and staff.
Ekegusii: Aase abanto bakoriera chindagera buna emebogani nere buya komanya na gotanga emechado eyio buna kobetereria gose kobasoi ase obosomba bwechinguru, kobatumia ase chinchera chiogokora obwanchani koegwa chibesa nayande, kobarenda abageni and nabakori emeremo babo.

English: Fishing industry environments pose risks of exploitation. Safety improvements at docks support worker protection.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yoborubi chinswe yaretire obwoba bwokorerwa bobe na koriananigwa. Gokongia oborendi aaria ase chinswe chigoikerigwa korwa obwato ngosira ere oborendi bwabokori emeremo.

English: Women living with HIV face increased risks and barriers. Integrated health, counseling, and legal services provide essential support.
Ekegusii: Abakungi bawate endwari yenyamoreo mbwango konyorwa nobobe nebitango. Obobwenia ase oboamo, obosemia, amo nogokonywa kemachiko nkorwabire ogokonya kwabeene.

English: Mining areas require strict policies and safety measures to prevent harassment and exploitation.
Ekegusii: Okorema amadini nigo koganetie amachiko amaikeranu noborendi gotanga okorera abande bobe, kogechi gose gochaya nakobarianania .

English: Market environments must establish reporting systems and committees to prevent harassment and extortion.
Ekegusii: Chichiro goika chibe nemeroberio egokonya abanyabiasara korwa okwemurangania kwabo gotanga gokorerwa bobe, kiogechigwa, kogosererigwa gose kobetererigwa gkorwa chibesa.

English: Residential facilities for persons with disabilities require strong safeguards and accessible education on rights and reporting.
Ekegusii: Aase abanto bamenyete na mono baria bare noborema chinchera chiokobarenda chingiya nchiganeirie na kobakonya goikera chisemi chioboronge na buna baranyare goteba ekero bakoreirwe bobe.

English: Higher education institutions must address campus sexual violence through comprehensive strategies and anonymous reporting.
Ekegusii: Chiyunifasiti goika chitange okobetereria, okogosereria gose gokorera abande bobe ekiagera eki bare goetera okomanyia abarai beyunifasiti otari kwemanyekani.

English: Refugee camps must prioritize safety planning, adequate lighting, and women’s participation in governance.
Ekegusii: Aaria chikambi chia baria batamire chisegi korwa chinsobo goika baroberie igoro yoborendi, oborabu boisaine ase chikambi chiabo, na gosangia abangina ase emeroberio yoborendi bwabo.

English: Government workplaces must maintain zero tolerance for harassment through training, accountability, and independent reporting systems.
Ekegusii: Aaria chiofisi chieserikari ase abanto bagokorera emeremo goika chitange ogokorerwa bobe, kobabetereria gose kobagosereria oetera okobasomia, obotenereri, nechinchera chiokorwa okwemurangania kwabo.

English: Climate disasters increase risks of violence. Preparedness must include violence risk assessments and mitigation actions.
Ekegusii: Emechando yogoonchoreria kwerire nigo egosegeta abanto gokorerwa bobe. Emeroberio yogwetanga nayio goika erigererie ebinto biragere ogkorerwa bobe gose kogosererigwa na buna baranyare gotangwa.

English: Children face online risks. Parents should monitor use, apply controls, and teach safe behavior.
Ekegusii: Abana mbare ase hatari goetera eintaneti. Abaibori goika bamongere buna abana babo bagotumia eintaneti, batabge na komanyia abana babo chinchera chingiya chibaretere emechando.

English: Suspected child abuse should be reported immediately to police or through the *116# anonymous helpline.
Ekegusii: Abana ekageire gokorerwa bobe gose gotibongwa goika eripoti erugwe gotachererwa gochia ase abasikari goetera enamba eye yesimi *116# otari kwemanyekania.

English: Child trafficking remains a major threat. Communities should report suspicious activity to authorities.
Ekegusii: Ogosoi abana ase ebinto bitancheiri, kobatamia gose kobabisa erio kobatumia ase chinchera chitabwenereti neringa rinene riokogosia. Ebinyoro goika birwe amang'ana igiro yebinto bare nechitangutangu ase abagambi gose abasikari.

English: Schools must implement protection policies, anti-bullying systems, and counseling services to safeguard learners.
Ekegusii: Chisukuru goika chiikerania amachiko oborendi, gokorera abana abande bobe, na korwa obosemia erio korenda abana buya.

English: Foster caregivers must be vetted to ensure safe environments for vulnerable children.
Ekegusii: Abaibori abarendi babana barigererigwa buya bataraegwa abana korenda erio korenda nga abana baria abake batanyare kwerenda.

English: Child marriage harms children’s health and future. Communities must report cases and support girls’ education.
Ekegusii: Enywomo yabana abake nigo egosaria afia yabana nobogima bwabo bwa motwe. Abanto goika barwe eripoti igoro yobobe obwo na gosira chisemi chiomwana omonyaroka.

English: Children experiencing trauma need psychological support available through free counseling services.
Ekegusii: Abana bare ase ogochandeka bwebirengererio mbagabeti ogokonywa kobakonya gokinania omochando oyio bosa goetera chinkwana nomonyagitari konyora chinguru chiogokinana nebirengererio.

English: Street-connected children require shelters, education, and reintegration programs for safety and development.
Ekegusii: Abana baria banarete obogima bwokobera ebisona ase chitaoni mbaganetie ase bakorara, chisemi, nemeroberio yokobairania chinka chiabo ase oborendi namagenderero.

English: Child labor is illegal. Report hazardous child work to the Labour Department or call 0800220444.
Ekegusii: Obosomba bwabana mamincha yerichiko. Karwe eripoti igoro yabana bare ase emeremo eranyare kobaretera emechando gochia chiofisi chitenererete obokori emeremo gose goaka esimi 0800220444.

English: Children involved in legal processes should receive specialized legal aid through the Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions.
Ekegusii: Abana abwo bare ase okoariganigwa gotamigwa mamincha yerichiko neganeirie konyora obokonyi mwachiko bosa goetera ofisi yomoteneneri bwobosoi ebina (ODPP).

English: Children should learn to protect personal information online and report suspicious interactions to trusted adults.
Ekegusii: Nere buya abana kwegera buna baranyare korenda amangana abo arikire are ase eintaneti na komanyia oyo begenete igoro yechitang'utang'u.

English: Domestic violence harms children. Report incidents to local authorities or child helplines.
Ekegusii: Chiburaburu chiekenyomba nigo chikoumisa gose gosaria abana. Karwe amangana igoro yaya gochia abagambi gose chiofosi chieserikari chirendete abana.

English: Government and NGOs support orphaned children with essential services. Adoption and foster care follow legal guidelines.
Ekegusii: Eserikari na NGOs ngokonya chire abana chitankana ase okobakonya ase chinchera ao ao chiengencho. Buna okogora abana ase enchera yamachiko gochia abaibiri bakabere na kobabwatia kemachiko komanya ng'a mbuya barendete abana abwo.

English: Every child has rights to education, healthcare, and protection. Communities must report violations.
Ekegusii: Kera omwana nare noboronge bwokonyora chisemi, obobwenia, na oborendi. Abanto goika barwe eripoti igoro yotaikeranigwa kwayio.

English: Bullying leads to depression and school dropouts. Schools must enforce strict anti-bullying policies and provide counseling for affected children.
Ekegusii: Ogokorera abande bobe nigo gokoreta ogochandeka kwebirengererio, ogoichania goika gotiga amasomo. Chisukuru nere buya kobeka amachiko amakong'u gotanga ogokorera abande bobe na korwa obosemia ase abana baria bakoreirwe bobe.

English: In disasters (floods, fires), children are most vulnerable. Ensure they are evacuated safely and receive psychosocial support.
Ekegusii: Ekero kiemebasekano buna (etoigo, nopgwateka kwemerero), abana nabwo bagochandeka mono ekiagera batari naguru chigokonya. Rora ng'a batammigwe gose korusigwa aroro buya na bae ogokonywa kwebirengererio goetra okobakwanera.

English: Sexual predators target children online and offline. Parents should monitor interactions and teach children about body safety.
Ekegusii: Ebibago bitagete gokoria abana chingencho chiobonyaka nigo bikembete abana goetera eintaneti gose kobaikera abanyene. Nere buya abaibori komongera okoererania chinkwana chiabo na kobanyia igoro yoborendi bwomebere yabo.

English: Children with disabilities face higher risks of abuse. Ensure inclusive education and accessible reporting mechanisms for their protection.
Ekegusii: Abana bare noborema nigo ere raisi ase bare gokorerwa bobe. Rora nga abana bonsi ba kera engencho banyorire chisemi na buna baranyare komanyia igoro yogokorerwa bobe ase oborendi bwabo.

English: Local communities should establish child protection committees to monitor and report abuse cases, working closely with government agencies.
Ekegusii: Nere buya ebinyoro koba nechikomiti igoro yoborendi bwa abana chikomongera na koripoti buna abana kogorerwa bobe, gokora emeremo yabo ase ase okobwaterana nebiombe bieserikari.

English: The Kenya Police have specialized desks to handle child-related cases with sensitivity and confidentiality. Report cases at any police station.
Ekegusii: Chipori stesheni nchire negetengo kiabeen kegosugurikia buna abana bakomecherwa buna ogoakwa, ogotibongwa, obosomba, okoiba gose gokengania abana ase enchera chiobosani nabana na erendete obobisi bwabana. Karwe eripoti ase porisi stesheni ende yonsi.

English: Neglect harms a child's development. Parents and guardians must provide basic needs, love, and security to prevent long-term trauma.
Ekegusii: Ogotarenda gose koa omwana ebinto atagete nigo ekogocha ogokina na okogenderera kwomwana. Abaibori nabarendi babana goika bae abana babo ebi bakonyara, buna obwanchani, noborendi gotanga mechando yebirengererio nogochandeka ase engaki entambe.

English: Refugee children are vulnerable to abuse and trafficking. Humanitarian agencies provide safe shelters and education in camps.
Ekegusii: Abana ba baria batamete chisegi korwa sobo igo ere raisi ase bare gokorerwa bobe gokenganigwa gose koibwa. Ebiombe bikorwanerera oboronge bwekemwanyabanto bieserikari nkorwa bire obomenyo obuya nechisemi aaria ase chikambi.

English: Some communities still practice harmful traditions involving children. Report such cases to authorities immediately.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande mbagenderete gokora ebienyechi buna ogekeba abanyaroka ebio bire mamincha noboronge bwa abana. Karwe eripoti yamang'ana ayio gochia ase abambi otari konyorwa.

English: Positive parenting reduces abuse risks. Attend government-sponsored parenting programs to learn child protection strategies.
Ekegusii: Oboreri obuya nigo bogokeania abana gokorerwa bobe. Soa gose kabe oyomo ase omoroberio bweserikari gosomigwa chinchera buna oranyare korenda abana.

English: Children involved in legal matters should go through specialized courts to ensure fair and trauma-sensitive proceedings.
Ekegusii: Ebina birengete abana goika ebina biabo bigamberwe ase chikoti chiabeene korora ng'a biagendiigwe buya birendete gotatubania obongo naende korwa obobe bwabete.

English: Underage drug use leads to crime and health issues. Schools and parents should educate children on substance abuse dangers.
Ekegusii: Abana abake konywa amarwa nigo gokogesa obosaria nemechando ya afia. Nere buya chisukuru nabaibori basomie abana igoro yemachando yokonywa amarwa.

English: Dial 116 (Child Helpline) or 999 (Emergency) to report child abuse, neglect, or exploitation for immediate assistance.
Ekegusii: Aka esimi 116 (Obokonyi ase Abana) gose 999 (Emebasekano) komnyia igoro yogokorerwa bobe kwomwana, ogoserigwa gose okwangwa, gose koba ase obosomba erio onyore ogokonya kegima.

English: Children in areas like Northern Kenya face abduction and recruitment into armed groups. Security agencies must prioritize their safety.
Ekegusii: Abana bare chinsemo chiria buna Kenya ya Irianyi nigo ere raisi ase bare koibwa na gosoigwa ase ebiombe biobokebago. Ebiombe bieserikari goika birwe birigerie ayio ase okobarenda.

English: Perpetrators of child abuse face severe penalties, including life imprisonment. Report offenders to ensure justice for victims.
Ekegusii: Ebibago biria bigosaria abana mbirigereririe negesusuro ekenene, gosse giibwa maisa. Ripoti ebibago ebio ase okorigia ekeene ase baria bokoreirwe bobe.

English: Schools in high-risk areas should have security measures to protect children from terrorist threats and abductions.
Ekegusii: Chisukuru chiria chire aase ere raisi abana gokorerwa bobe mbuya chibe nomoroberio omuya bwoborendi korenda abana korwa obwoba bwebibago koruta chipomu noboibi bwechiombe.

English: Children's identities can be stolen for fraud. Parents should safeguard birth certificates and monitor credit reports.
Ekegusii: nabo ekonyarekana nga ebiband biabana bibwe gokorera obongainereria. Abaibori brende buya chisatificate chiokoiborwa chia abana babo no komongera buna chibesa chigosao chisimi chiabo.

English: Victims of sexual abuse need medical, legal, and psychological support. Specialized centers offer free services nationwide.
Ekegusii: Baria bakoreirwe bobe gose gotibongwa nere buya konyora obokonyi bwobobwenia, kemachiko, anakebirengererio. Chisenta chiegeirie gokora emeremo eyio nkorwa chire obokonyi bwa bosa Kenya engima.

English: Many children drown in open water sources. Parents should supervise kids near pools, rivers, and wells.
Ekegusii: Abana abange nigo bkogwa nagokwera ime yechinsemo chiamache. Abaibiri goika barande abana babio ekero bare ange nase aria agoakerwa ontimbu, chindoche, amo nechinsoko.

English: Churches and mosques must vet staff and implement policies to prevent child abuse within their facilities.
Ekegusii: Chikanisa nemesikiti goika bakongori abakori emeremo babo na goikerania amachiko agotanga gokorera abana bobe imse yechinyomba chiikanisa gose emesikiti.

English: Media should avoid exposing children to harmful content and respect their privacy when reporting on abuse cases.
Ekegusii: Abariki na baria bagotangasa amang'ana goika barende gotanga nga amangana agosaria abana ase ogotatora amarieta abo nase barwete ekero bakomanyia amangan buna abana bagokorerwa bobe.

English: Criminal gangs exploit children for begging. Report such cases to the police for rescue and rehabilitation.
Ekegusii: Ebibago nigo bigotumia ribaga riabana gotenyara ase ogosaberera. Manyia abasikari kobakonya na kobarongei.

English: Ensure school vans are properly licensed and drivers vetted to prevent accidents and kidnappings.
Ekegusii: Rora nga chirori chisukuru nchuibwate chirensesi buya nomotereba buya achoretwe korenga gotanga emebasekano na koibwa kwa abana.

English: Extremist groups target vulnerable children. Communities should report suspicious recruitment activities.
Ekegusii: Ebiobago biria bigosaria amongo abanto na kobaira obokebago bwokotuta chipomu nigo nigo birengete abana baria batari kwenyara gose korwa emchie emetaka . Abanto gioka barwe eripoti igoro yebinto bare nechitang'utang'u nabirobio gose okorikwa gosoa obokebago obwo.

English: Hospitals should have trained staff to handle child abuse cases with confidentiality and care.
Ekegusii: Chinyagitari mbuya koba nabakori emeremo begeirie gosugurikia ogokorerwa bobe kwabana ase obobisi obonene noborendi boisaine.

English: Teach children fire safety measures and ensure homes have working smoke detectors to prevent tragedies.
Ekegusii: Somia abana chinhera chiokwerenda nomorero na rora ng'a chinka chibwate egento keria gekomanya ekero erioki rireo erio gokonya gotanga emerero gwateka.

English: Online games can expose children to predators. Parents should monitor gaming interactions and set time limits.
Ekegusii: Chigosori chieintaneti nigo chigosuguma abana ang'e gochia ase ebibago biabo. Abaibori goika bamongere chingaki abana bakorrigereria chigosori na ase chinsa gete.

English: Families should include children in disaster drills and ensure they know emergency contacts.
Ekegusii: Chifamiri goika chisangie abana babo amo koroberia buna baranyare gotange omorero tibwateka sobo na ekero bwatekire ase bagotamera gochia nechinamba chiesimi barangerie konyora ogokonya.

English: Teach children stranger danger rules and ensure they travel in groups. Report missing children immediately.
Ekegusii: Somia abana tibakwana omonto batamanyeti gose kobwatia amang'ana yomonto batamanyeti buna enchere engiya yokwerenda na gotara amo abanto abange. Karwe amangana igoro yomonto otaoyi otari konyorwa gochia ase abambi gose porisi.

English: Businesses must avoid employing children and support initiatives for their education instead.
Ekegusii: Abanyabiasara goika barende tibarika abana buna abkori emeremo yabo korende basire emeroberio yogokonya ng'a bachire esukuru gosoma.

English: Sports academies must have policies against physical and sexual abuse of young athletes.
Ekegusii: Aaria ase abanto bagosomera gokora chogosori goika babe namachiko agotanga gokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki ore gose ogotabatabwa ase abanyagosori abasae.

English: Keep medicines and chemicals out of children's reach to avoid accidental poisoning incidents.
Ekegusii: Beka amariogo mo nebinto biria bionsi bire hatari ase abana are korwa ase bare buna enchera eyemo yogotanga abana konywa chisumu ase egesio ekebe.

English: Event organizers should provide child-safe spaces and lost-child protocols during large gatherings.
Ekegusii: Baria bakoroberria emeyega nere buya kobekaase abana basirete bakobekwa negento abaibiri basireriigwe nabana babo babwenerete gokora ekero kiesangerekano emenene.

English: Tourist hotspots sometimes exploit children for labor or sex. Report such cases to the Tourism Regulatory Authority.
Ekegusii: Aase abanto bakorwa isiko (abatari) bagotarera chingaki chinyinge nigo akoba aase abana bagokorigwa egasi gose gotibongi. Karwe eripoti gochia baria batenenerete obotari.

English: Kenya's laws are evolving to better protect children's rights. Stay informed on legal changes affecting child welfare.
Ekegusii: machiko a Kenya akongiigwe erio korenda abana baria batari konyara kwerenda gose korwa emechie emetaka erio korenda oboronge bwa abana. Kabe gokomanyigwa igoro yamaonchorerio arengete ebiombe biabana.

English: Neighbors, teachers, and relatives must speak up against child abuse to create safer environments for children.
Ekegusii: Abaamate,abarimu, na abairi goika bakwenere ringana igoro yabana gokorerwa bobe erio korora ng'a abana tibari ase hatari yogokorerwa bobe.

English: Livestock theft remains a challenge in pastoralist regions. Communities should form watch programs, brand animals, and report suspicious activities.
Ekegusii: Oboibi bwechiombe nabo botigarete koba omochando aaria chinsemo chiobotugi. Nere buya ebinyoro koba nemeroberio yobomongeri, basambererie chiombe chiabo chinamba, na korwa eripoti igoro yamangana bare nechitangutangu naro.

English: Regular vaccination protects livestock from major diseases. Veterinary services offer free campaigns during high-risk seasons and farmers should keep records.
Ekegusii: Ogochancha etugo ase chingaki chionsi nigo egotanga amarwaire yetugo korwa amanene. Abanyagitari betugo nkoba bare negeseto chingaki endwari yetugo egwateks na mbuya abaremi koba nomobaro bwetugo yabo.

English: Water scarcity during droughts causes losses. Farmers should adopt water harvesting methods such as dams, pans, and subsurface storage.
Ekegusii: Ogokeana kwamache chingaki chieguragura nigo ekorenta asara Nere buya abaremi kwegera gotacha na kogacha amache ase okorema chingoro, kogora ebibuyu ebinene, koagacha chitangi chia'mahe inse yeriraba.

English: Biosecurity prevents disease outbreaks. Disinfect footbaths, quarantine new animals, control wildlife access, and report sick animals promptly. Proper carcass disposal is essential.
Ekegusii: Gotanga okoererania etugo korwa ensemo eyemo gochia eyende nigo egotana okwambokerana kwamarwaire yetugo nabanto. Beta chiombe esindani yoborwaire bwomonwa namagoro, chiombe chikorwaa gochia aria chichanche, renda chingiti chiorosana tichiika ange, na karwe eripoti ioro yetugo erwarete otrikonyorwa. Tindeka etugo eri yakure inse kabisa.

English: The Kenya Livestock Identification and Traceability System assigns herd numbers and ear tags to support theft prevention and disease control.
Ekegusii: Omoreoberio o'Kenya komanya etugo, na komanya ase yarwete ngosambereria ore chiombe chinamba gose gochikera chinamba ase amato buna enchera yogotanga oboibi.

English: Wildlife predation causes losses. Farmers should construct predator-proof enclosures and use guard animals. Compensation is available for verified cases.
Ekegusii: Ogoitwa gwetugo nechingiti chiorosana buna endagera yabo nigo gokoreta asara ase omoremi. Nere buya abaremi koagacha gose kogitera etugo yabo buya gotanga chingiti chiorosana goikera etugo yabo na koyeita bua endagera yabo. Ogoakanwa ase baria etugo yabo yaitetwe nechingiti chiorosana nereo ase baria bagitere etugo yabo buya.

English: Index-based livestock insurance protects pastoralists from drought losses using satellite data triggers.
Ekegusii: Ensuarence erendete abaremi bobotugi nereo ekero rioka yamanyakinire nga omobaso omonene gose etoigo gose ogwateka kwendwari etare konyarekana ekorenda abatugi gotera ebimoreki bieintenet igoro aa ase rire bokorenga ekerengo omochando ore gokonys chiinsuarence komanya nechibesa irenga bagoakana omoremi.

English: Unauthorized livestock movement spreads disease. Farmers should demand permits and follow quarantine notices.
Ekegusii: Okoererania gwetugo gotancheirie nigo kogotaria amarwaire. Nere buya abaremi basabe rirube rikobanchera goetia etugo korwa aa gochia aari na kobwatia amachiko ogochancha chitugo chiabo.

English: Proper slaughter methods protect meat safety. Only use licensed slaughterhouses or follow public health guidelines for home slaughter.
Ekegusii: Obonyenyi etugo obuya na gacha enyama buya protect. Tumia ebichinchio biria biancheire gose bwatia amachiko yobochenu ekero okonyenya etugo yao nka.

English: Certain plants poison livestock. Farmers should remove toxic plants and provide alternative fodder during drought. Veterinary analysis supports diagnosis.
Ekegusii: Ekero etugo yarire emete gete nigo ekoba esumu mebere yabo. Nere buya abaremi batogore emete buna eyio yonsi na koa chitugo chiabo obonyansi obuya chinaki chiguragura. Ogopima etugo yao nomonyagitari bwetugo nabio bikoenekia ayio.

English: Ticks spread deadly diseases. Regular dipping, chemical rotation, and daily inspections protect livestock.
Ekegusii: Amagecha nigo agotambokeri amairwaire amabe ase etugo. Koira etugo chidipu, gochenchia amariogo ase edipu, gose goyesibia ase okoyesiarera eriogo riogoita amagecha nepambu, na korigereria kera rituko nga etugo yao tebwati amagecha.

English: Drought requires special management. Provide minerals, reduce herd size early, and conserve water.
Ekegusii: Eguragura nego eganitie emeroberio emeikernu korenda amache, gosiarera ebimeri amache, na koa etugo amache okonywa. Karwe amache echichuba, keania obonge bwetugo yao genkioy, na gacha amache.

English: Proper feed storage prevents aflatoxin contamination. Keep grains dry, mold-free, and securely stored.
Ekegusii: Kogacha endagrera buya nigo egokonya ogotabosa kwendagera.

English: Early reporting prevents outbreaks. Contact veterinary officers or the Toll-Free Animal Disease Hotline 0800721313.
Ekegusii: Korwa eripoti bwango igoro yamarwaire gochia ase abanyagitari nigo egotanga oborwaire kwambokerana/koranda. Manyia omonyagitari bwetugo rangeria esimi eye yamorero 0800721313 otari goakana kende.

English: Climate change increases animal risks. Provide shade, drainage, windbreaks, and use early warning systems.
Ekegusii: Ogoonchoreria kwerire nigo gokogesa emechando ase atugo. Beka etugo yao inse yekiriri, emetaro yogosokia amache amachafu, chimbago gotanga embeo, na komanya bwango igoro yogoonchoreria kwerire bwebage.

English: Milk safety requires hygiene. Wash udders, use clean containers, cool milk, and sell only to licensed processors.
Ekegusii: Okogacha amere buya neganetie obochenu. Sibia enyeri nechimbere buya, beka amabere ase egento ekerabu, kendia amabere, na yaoneri bari bawete amarube yokobanchera koonia amabere boke.

English: Internal parasites reduce productivity. Deworm regularly, rotate grazing, and test fecal samples.
Ekegusii: Ebianda nigo bikei amabere. Kae etugo yao eriogo riebianda, onchoreria ase okorisia etugo yao korwa aa gochia aaria, na pima esike yetugo yao komanya gose nere nebianda.

English: Pastoralist migrations need planning. Obtain permits, choose safe routes, and avoid conflict areas.
Ekegusii: Okonganya korwa aa gochia aaria kwa abatugi nkoganetie emeroberio emiya. Nyora ogwancherwa gwokong'anya netugo yao, etera ase atari nemechando, kabe are korwa chingongo chiria chire neminano.

English: Misuse of veterinary drugs creates resistance. Buy from licensed sources and follow prescriptions.
Ekegusii: Koa etugo amriogo otabirie nabanyagitari betugo nigo egosaria obonyamasi bwetugo gose amariogo atari gokora egasi buya ase etugo. Gora amariogo korwa amonyagitari omoronge eriogo ribwate amalezo buya.

English: Accurate records improve management. Track births, deaths, treatments, and vaccinations.
Ekegusii: Amariko abwate maeleso yoboremi bwetugo yao nigo akogokonya ase emeroberio yao. Bwatia komanya chitariki chia kera etugo ekero yabiaretwe, ogokwa, buna kwarure obobwenia, na gochichancha.

English: Beehive theft is rising. Secure apiaries, mark hives, and report suspicious buyers.
Ekegusii: Oboibi bwemetana yechinchoke mbogendererete kogeseka. Renda buya emetana, yebeka chinamba, na manyia igoro yabagori bakengeka.

English: Industrial pollutants harm animals. Report dumping, fence off contaminated sites, and test water.
Ekegusii: Obochafu bokorwa ase chifakitori nigo bokorentera etugo obokongu. Karwe eripoti igoro gotuguta obochafu bwabo ase enchera etari engiya, gita aase eubochafu bogotugutwa, na pima amche komanya gose nabwate ebinyinyi.

English: Floods kill animals and spread disease. Move herds to higher ground and disinfect pens after floods.
Ekegusii: Omogoko omonene nigo ogoita etugo na okoranda kwendwarim yetugo. Siarera obweri eriogo motwe yemegoko.

English: Community policing reduces livestock theft. Share intelligence and support police investigations.
Ekegusii: Oborendi bwebinyoro nogo bogokeania oboibi bwetugo. Karwe amanagana obotuki na bwatisia porisi kobeka oborendi.

English: Proper manure handling prevents disease. Compost before use and store away from water sources.
Ekegusii: Kogacha na gotumia bobe obwoyo buya nigo kogokeania amarwaire. Karwe ribaga risaine ase eubo koguna na goonchoreria koba obwoyo omanye kobotumia na bobeke are korwa ase amache.

English: Snakes bite animals in dry seasons. Clear bushes and seek immediate treatment for bites.
Ekegusii: Chingiti chingenda nse nkorasa chire etugo aaria chingongo chinyomo. Rabia orsana na rigia obowenia bwa bwango ase etugo yao rasirwe neng'iti engenda nse.

English: Poor transport harms animals. Ensure ventilation, avoid extreme heat, and inspect animals after transport.
Ekegusii: Okobogoria etugo bobe nechirori nigo akoumisa etugo. Rora nga erori okobogoreria etugo yao nebwate ebigorero bisaine koreta embeo ime, renda nga riberera tibucha erori ime, na rigereria buya nga etugo mbuya ere magega goika ase kware koyeira.

English: Auction yards attract criminals. Use licensed yards, verify buyers, and maintain registers.
Ekegusii: Ase ebinto bigoakerwa omonada nigo akongusa ebibago. Akera omonada aase aitabire neserikari, rigereria buya abagori baino, na gacha buya amariko buna ogoaka omonada ebinto ebio.

English: Contaminated feed causes losses. Test for aflatoxins and store feed safely.
Ekegusii: Endaera enchafu yetugo nigo ekorenta asara. Pima komanya gose engaera eyio nebwae obobosu na gacha endagera eyio buya.

English: Large birds prey on young livestock. Use scare devices and provide sheltered pens.
Ekegusii: Ebibaki na makotu nigo akira ebichichu buna endagera yabo. Gitera etugoyao buya na rosia ebinto binga buna omonto obogoretie enyimbo gochia igoro na koyeka aroro kogosa ebinto ebio bitgete koira etugo.

English: Disaster preparedness reduces losses. Identify evacuation routes and store emergency supplies.
Ekegusii: Kweroberia buya nyuma yemechando nigo ogotanga asara. Orokia chinchera chiokominchoreria ekero kiemebasekano na gacha endagera orarie ekero kiemebasekano.

English: Water points attract thieves. Water animals by day and patrol high-risk areas.
Ekegusii: Ase amache akobucherwa nigo akongusa ebibago. Ira chiombe kere mobaso konywa amache animals no mokera buya aase okagerete abaibi barabaise korwera.

English: Animal noise disturbs communities. Proper housing reduces noise and prevents complaints.
Ekegusii: Okwana gwechiombe nigo gokogechia abanto. Koagacha obweri obuya nigo bogotanga eriogi riokwana na igo gotanga abanto kwemurangania.

English: Stray animals destroy property. Maintain secure fencing and report damage promptly.
Ekegusii: Etugo yabagoire nigo egosari ebimeri biabanto. Gitera buya etugo yao na manyia abanyene ekero etugo yao yasaririe ebinto bia bande.

English: Dry season fires threaten grazing areas. Create firebreaks and report arson incidents.
Ekegusii: Omorero chingaki chieguragura nigo okorenta obokongu ase oborisia bwetugo. Onye omogondo bwendagera gose rinani ore omonene, yobarore gati gati na koyatiga atri namete gose obonyansi gotanga omorere gotamboka gochia asande na manyia abarai onye nomonto bwogetie obomorero eyio makusudi.

English: Proper breeding management prevents injuries. Use healthy stock, maintain hygiene, and record breeding dates.
Ekegusii: Renda korora nga ekero etugo yao ekobwata embego yakorirwe ase enchera engiya etarikoumisa etugo eria ekobwata embego. Tumia eeri ebwate afia engiya , renda obochenu, na rika inse chitariki kwaete etugo yao embego.

English: Equipment theft affects productivity. Secure tools and machinery and report theft immediately.
Ekegusii: Oboibi bwebinto bioboremi buna chitinga chiokorem nebinde nigo bikoirania magega gose gokei rigesa. Gacha buya ebinto biao biogokora oboremi buya na manyia abagambi igoro yoboibi biebinto biao bioboremi bwngo.

English: Lightning kills grazing animals. Install lightning rods and avoid tying animals to isolated trees.
Ekegusii: Enkoba nigo egoita etugo ere getii korisia. Beka ebinto biria bikobwata enkoba na tiga gosiba etugo ase omote ore oymo.

English: Misuse of antibiotics creates resistance. Follow prescriptions and dispose of drugs safely.
Ekegusii: Ekero amariogo aria agotanga ebinyinyi komenta omobere ime agotumeka bobe, nigo akoa ebinyinyi chinguru goika eriogo riasinywa gokora egasi yobobwenia buya. Bwatia amereso omonyagitari buya na tuguta amariogo ase enchera engiya buna eyokoyatindeka.

English: Large gatherings increase theft risks. Supervise herds and coordinate with security agencies.
Ekegusii: Omoganda omonenenbwabanto nigo okongusa abaibi. Renda etugo yao buya na bwaterana nabarendi boborendi.

English: Plan feed supplies to avoid shortages. Preserve fodder and use drought-resistant varieties.
Ekegusii: Rosia na kogacha endagera yetugo yao genkio gotanyorwa nobokongu abwo motwe. Gacha endagera yetugo yao buya na simeka endagera yetugo eria ekoremereria omogaso omonene.

English: Blue-green algae poison animals. Avoid contaminated water sources and report cases.
Ekegusii: Esosera ime yamache rooche nigo ere esumu ase etugo ekero yayenyure. Renda korora nga ebiberero biamache nebirabu. Renda nga etugo yao terikonywa amache korwa aase achafu na manyia abangagitari betugo ekero etugo yarwarire.

English: Multiple identification methods enhance security. Brands, tags, and microchips support recovery.
Ekegusii: Beka etugo yao ebimanyererio ao ao gokonya kobirenda korwa oboibi. Chisambererie ekemanyererio, beka chipachi amato, and Kobekera chiombe ekagento gete ime yerisankwa riabo nechera eyemo yogotanga oboibi bwetugo ekiagera ekero yaibirwe egento keria kebisire ime yerisankwa nabo gekoorokia goetera eintaneti ase etugo eyio ere nakoyebwatia bwango.

English: Poor handling causes stress and injury. Use non-slip floors and proper restraint equipment.
Ekegusii: Ekero etugo ekoirwa ase enchera etari engiya nigo ekoba nobwoba, ogochandeka ebirengererio an koumia. Beka etugo aase atari noboterere na yesibe buya.

English: Faulty electrical systems harm animals. Inspect wiring and test for stray voltage regularly.
Ekegusii: Esitima etbikirie buya nabo are hatari ase etugo. Rora gose chigwaya nchiererete inse na gopima gose nchire nomorero kera engaki erio korenda etugo teakwa nesisitima.

English: Steep water edges trap animals. Install gentle slopes and fence dangerous areas.
Ekegusii: Koira etugo rooche konya amache aase are egetionko nabo etugo aranyare gotereria na kogwa amache ime ekwe. Rosia buya aase etugo yao ekonywera amache na gita aase are atari ase etugo.

English: Research farms need strict security. Use CCTV, controlled access, and patrols.
Ekegusii: Aaria ase oboremi bogokorerwa amasomo ogotema ao ao naganetie oborendi obuya. Tumia ebimoreki biria biekamera bikobwata buna abanto bagosoa nagosoka, renda nga tari kera omonto ogosoa aroro, nobomongeri obuya.

English: High temperatures reduce productivity. Provide shade, ventilation, and constant water.
Ekegusii: Ekero riberera rire igoro mono nigo rigokei amabere ase etugo. Beka ekiriri, karwe ribaga ase embeo rgoetera, na beka amache okonya ase etugo chingaki chionsi.

English: Early warning prevents losses. Monitor conditions and share forecasts with herders.
Ekegusii: Komanya omochando bwango nigo kogotanga asara. Rigeria buya komanya rire buna rire na sanga nabatugi bamino.

English: Be cautious of investment apps advertised during football matches on illegal streams. Many are fronts for data theft or financial fraud
Ekegusii: Erende korwa omochieso ogotangaswa ase chisimi kobeka chibesa ase etimi gete ng'a nonyore chibesa goetra esimi chingaki chiegosri yomopira. Abange ba abwo bakorenta chigosori echi nigo barengete koiba amanga iigoro yao bakorere oboibi.

English: "DCI is investigating a fake 'youth startup grant' program circulating on TikTok and Instagram. There is no such initiative funded by the Government of Kenya."
Ekegusii: Abanyanyimbo mbagendererete gotuka igoro yogochaka ogokonywa ase abasae neserikari ya Kenya goetera TikTok na Instagram. Gento kenga buna ekio tikeiyo korende noborimo bwoka.

English: The Ministry of Public Service reminds job seekers that all internship postings are free to apply for. Avoid anyone asking for bribes or airtime in return
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yobokoreri bwabanto nkoinyoria are abakorogia egasi nga baria bakorigia gosoa ase okwegera mono igoro yamosomo abo nigo agwancherwa na gosoa bosa. Kana monto onde bwensi oragosabe riaki.

English: Several Kenyans have reported scam calls claiming to be from international couriers requesting customs clearance payments. Confirm such calls with KRA or the courier directly
Ekegusii: Abakenya abange banyorire chisimi korwa ebobagp bikobasaba chibesa gose kobaa amanga igoro yabo korwa abakweroka buna baria bagokora emeremo yobobogoria emesigo korwa chinse chia isiko mbare nomosigo oo abae chibesa chiogoetia omoesigo iyio erio bagokonye. Koranyore esimi yengencho etye manyia office chia chiebango (KRA) gose ekambani eyio bakogotebi.

English: "Be cautious of business mentorship programs advertised by influencers that ask for hefty registration fees. Many lack legal registration."
Ekegusii: Renda kegima tosoa ase emeroberio yogosomia igoro goetera chisimi nabanto bare nokobua gokong'ina nakobebegena bagosaba chibesa chinyinge gosoera Abange babanto aba tiberigeti neserikari.

English: "We urge wananchi to report any person asking for 'expedited NHIF services' in exchange for cash. NHIF does not charge for processing."
Ekegusii: Nigo togosaba abanto komanyia abagambi gose abasikari igoro yabanto bagosaba chibesa basuguikie akadi yao ya NHIF ekore egasi. NHIF teri gosaba besa goetia emesigo.

English: The Judiciary warns of false bail refund letters sent to unsuspecting litigants. Refunds are processed only through court registries
Ekegusii: Ekoti yaonyire abanto igoro yamarube oborimo ogotomwa gochia ekoti korigia koiranerigwa chibesa babegete ebondi false bail refund letters sent to unsuspecting litigants. Okoiranerigwa chibesa chiepondi nkotini kogokorerwa na tari ande onsi.

English: "Ministry of Housing has not contracted any agents to collect payments for affordable housing units. Application is done through Boma Yangu portal only."
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yobokoreri bwabanto nkoinyoria ere abakorogia egasi nga baria bakorigia gosoa ase okwegera mono igoro yamosomo abo nigo agwancherwa na gosoa bosa. Kana monto onde bwensi oragosabe riaki.

English: Red Cross Kenya cautions citizens against donation drives using MPESA till numbers not registered to the organization. Always crosscheck before sending money.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe Ekebaririri gia Kenya kiarure ogokurerwa ase abanainchi igoro yemechango goetera MPESA chinamba chia till chitarikiri rasimi na Safaricom ase abwo bagosaba omochango . Tema komanya buya nyuma otatatoma chibesa chiao.

English: Public warning: PSC does not conduct interviews on WhatsApp. Any job ad asking for 'application fees' is fake and should be reported
Ekegusii: Ogokurera ase bonsi: Enseo yesrikari eria etenenerete emeremo yeserikari (PSC) teri gokria abanto ogotema gwokorigia emeremo goetra Whatsapp. Any job ad asking for 'application fees' is fake and should be reported

English: "CBK is aware of mobile apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. CRB requests are processed through licensed bureaus only."
Ekegusii: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK ) nemanyete ebikoreri biechisimi apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. Ogosaba gochia baria batenenerete ogosaria kwobogoko (CRB) nigo kogokorwa nabanto bancheire gokora egasi eyio boka"

English: EACC has flagged a syndicate offering forged title searches and valuations in Kisumu. Use verified government channels only
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) yarure ogokurerwa igoro yamarube oborimo koa abanto emeremo, gose chinamba chiamaremo chioborimo, na korenga oboremo obwo nga nirenga boisaine aaria Kisumu. Tumia chiofisi chieserikari ekero otagete komanya ayio boronge.

English: "DCI confirms arrests of fake NGO representatives claiming to partner with World Food Programme in Northern Kenya. Always verify through official NGO registry."
Ekegusii: "Omotuki omonene enekirie okobwatwa kwa abatenereri be'NGO boborimo bakweroka abakobwaterana nekeombe kia Omoroberio Bwendagera Bwense (World Food Programme) aaria Kenya ya Irianyi. Botambe manya boronge korwa egetabu gia NGO."

English: "Wanafunzi wanaombwa wasitumie wasimamizi wasiojulikana kusajili HELB. Maafisa bandia wamekuwa wakichukua pesa wakiahidi kufanikisha mkopo."
Ekegusii: "Abana babioriigwe tibatumia abatenereri batamanyekaneti ekero bakwerika konyora ogokonya gwechibesa korwa HELB. Abanene ba pandia babeire bagosaba chibesa ase okobatebia ng'a mbabae chibesa chieroni ya HELB."

English: Communications Authority warns of cloned betting apps circulating on Telegram. Many steal your phone data and banking information
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete okoererania amangana ase embeo kiarure ogokurera igoro yegokoreri gia bahati na sibu kioborimo kerandete ase Telegram. Abange nigo bakoiba amanga ao are ase esimi amo nayenamba yebengi yao.

English: KRA reminds taxpayers that agents are not allowed to collect cash payments in person. Use official PayBill numbers and receipts
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giokorusia ebango gia Kenya (KRA) nkoinyoria kere baakani abango nga abaachenti babo tibaganeirie korusia ebango gose koegwa chibesa tbarabwo abanyene. Tumia enamba yabeene ya PayBill na nyora risiti riogoakana.

English: "We urge Kenyans to confirm job offers from airlines, especially Emirates and Qatar Airways. Multiple scams promising airport jobs have been flagged.
Ekegusii: "Nigo togosaba abakenya komanya buya amatangaso yechigasi korwa ase ebitii bienchindege, mono kobua buna keria Emirates na Qatar. Amatangaso amange yoborimo igoro yemeremo ase ebitii biechindege bwaansire.

English: EACC is investigating individuals posing as ministry auditors soliciting bribes from small schools. All inspections are officially scheduled and documented
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwani obopkorekanu (EACC) ngotuka kere abanto gete bagwekora baria bakorigereria amatumisi yechibesa chieserikari na igo gosaba amaaki korwa ase chisukuru chinke. Okorigererigwa bwebitabu nigo gokoba ekero gwatangasirwe.

English: "CBK reminds Kenyans that legitimate banks do not conduct promotions via Facebook inboxes. Ignore messages asking for account details to 'activate rewards'."
Ekegusii: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) nkoinyoria ere abanto ba Kenyan ng'a chibengi boronge tichiri gokinia abakori emeremo babo goetera Facebook. Ombia mang'ana ande onsi akogosaba obae ennamba yao yebengi erio bakobekere ekeegwa gie chibesa."

English: "DCI warns against conmen selling fake 'church land' in Kayole and Ruai. Verify ownership documents at the Ministry of Lands before making any payment."
Ekegusii: "Omotuki omonene orure ogokurera gochia abangainereria baria bakkonia amaremo echikanisa ataiyo aari kayole na Ruai. Manya buya abanyene oboremo ase ofisi chia amaremo otaraakana besa chinde chionsi."

English: NSSF alerts contributors to disregard WhatsApp messages claiming there is a special withdrawal window for those over 40. No such provision exists.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kiabagotu (NSSF) giakureire abanto baye bonsi baombie amanga ande onsi korwa WhatsApp agotebia abanto ng'a baria bonsi baikire emiaka 40 nkonyarekana ere korusia chibesa chiabo. Mang'ana anga buna ayio taiyo.

English: Be cautious of investment apps advertised during football matches on illegal streams. Many are fronts for data theft or financial fraud.
Ekegusii: Erende korwa amatangaso yokonyora chibesa goetera chitimu chiomopira chikobua chigotangaswa ekero kiemepira egoakwa ase abarimo gagwesoi ime. Abange babwo nigo barengete komanya na koiba amangana yebinto biao bakoibere nonya nechibesa.

English: "The Judiciary has received complaints about fake court summons sent via email. Summons are never delivered electronically or through WhatsApp
Ekegusii: "EkKoti yanyorire okwemurunganania okonge igoro yokorangerigwa kwa abanto baike kotini ase enchera yoborimo goetera eintaneti. Amangana yokorangerigwa goika kotini tari gotomwa goetera eintaneti gose goetera Whatsapp.

English: EACC warns of imposters offering job placements at parastatals for upfront cash. All official job listings are published on PSC and organization websites.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) giakureire abakwebeka buna mbare namabaga ase yemeremo ase chikambani chiserikari ase okobaakana besa inke. Emeremo yonsi yeserikari nigo egotangaswa ase ensemo yeserikari tenerete emeremo yeserikari (PSC) na ase eintaneti yechikambani echio.

English: "People have been sent 'Safaricom refund claim' links that look like the real site. Safaricom does not issue refunds without an official claim form."
Ekegusii: "Abanto batomeirwe amang'ana koiranigwa chibesa ase bare ase egsio ekebe korwa safaricom. 'Ogosabwa oko koirania chibesa nigo kogokorwa ase enchera omonto okonayra kwegena. Safaricom teri gosaba koiranigwa gwechibesa otaichoretie efomu yabeene."

English: The Ministry of Transport has received reports of fake NTSA agents collecting bribes along major highways. Report any suspicious activity via 999 or NTSA portal
Ekegusii: Emonistiri yobobogoria yanyorire amang'ana igoro yabateneneri boborimo ba (NTSA) bagosaba amaaki ase chinhera chinene. Karwe amangana igoro yamang'ana anga buna ayio are nechitang'utang'u naro goetera enamba yesimi yamorero 999 gose eintaneti ya (NTSA)

English: "CBK reminds Kenyans that any investment requiring you to recruit others to earn returns is likely a pyramid scheme. Report such activities immediately."
Ekegusii: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) nkoinyoria ere aba'Kenyan ng'a moroberio bwokobeka chibesa ande yonsi eganetie orike abanto gosoa aroro erio konyora eng'eria rnigo enga buna emeroberio yoboibi buna eria ya pyramid scheme. Karwe eripoti ya yobokenga ebwo kegima kwayarora."

English: "Fraudsters posing as election observers have been soliciting money from aspirants for fake clearance. IEBC does not charge for clearance forms."
Ekegusii: "Abangainereria bagwekora buna abarigereria buna chikura chigoakwa babeire bagosangereria chibesa korwa ase baria bakorigia chikura kobarusia korwa erkodi yogokora bobe. Ekeombe keria gietenenerete buna chikura chiogoakwa (IEBC) nkeri gosaba chibesa erio korigereria gose nore namamocho aragotange toboria goakerwa chikura."

English: We advise Kenyans not to share photos of their ID, NHIF or voters card on Facebook job groups. These details are being harvested for fraud
Ekegusii: Nigo togosemia abanto ba Kenya tibasanga chipicha chibibande chiabana babo, chiria chia nyagitari (NHIF ) gose chikadi chiogoaka chikura ase okorigia emeremo goetera Facebook. Amangana aya yabana bao nigo agotumika gokora obosaria.

English: NSSF has suspended several field agents found collecting cash for 'special processing. NSSF does not charge for fast-tracking services
Ekegusii: Ekeoombe keria ekenene kiabagotu (NSSF) kiabutire abakori emeremo abange banyoretwe bagosangereria chibesa korwa abagotu erio kobakonya korosia chibesa chiobogotu bwabo. NSSF teri gosaba besa chinde chionsi ekero ekobwatia komanya ayakorengete.

English: Several students have lost fees to fake school accounts shared on WhatsApp. Always pay school fees through officially designated bank accounts.
Ekegusii: Abana abange basisiririe chibesa chiesukuru fisi goetera chiakaonti chioborimo chibekire WhatsApp. Chingaki chionsi akana chibesa chiesukuru goetera ebengi yesukuru yekeene.

English: KRA warns taxpayers not to use agents who claim they can erase penalties for a fee. All tax waivers are issued through formal channels.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete korusia ebango (KRA) kiarure ogokurera ase baria bagoakana chikodi chiabo tibatumia abaachenti abwo bakobang'aina nga nabo baranyare gotinyia chifaini chiabo ase okorwa gento geke. Okonacherwa gose kogokeaneri abango nigo kogokorwa goetera enchera ya ofisi yoka.

English: Those job ads for 'NGO agents hiring enumerators' without an interview are a scam. Verify with the actual NGO before sending money."
Ekegusii: Amangana ogosegeta korwa abaagenti ba'NGO ng'a nkorika bare abanto bakorika amang'ana gotakorigwa ogotemwa kwemeremo namangana oborimo. Manya boronge ng'a NGO ki yatomete amang'ana ayio."

English: EACC notes rising cases of impersonation in procurement offices. Report anyone claiming to 'influence' tender outcomes
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokorekanu (EACC) kiarorire ng'a ekogeseka kwobosaria bwogwekora abakori emeremo ba eofisi yobogori bweserikari. Karwe eripoti igoro ya monto onde oresio kobukania obogori bwechitenda chuieserikari

English: "The Ministry of Agriculture has disowned individuals collecting registration fees for 'subsidized fertilisers. All legitimate lists are displayed at ward offices."
Ekegusii: "Eminisitiri yoboremi yangire abanto abanto bagosangereria chibesa chiokwerika ase okonyora obwoyo bweserikari. Amariko akworokia emeroberio eyio nkonantigwa are ase kera Ewodi Yomokansera oino."

English: CBK warns Kenyans against sending money to social media groups promising weekly payouts from investment plans. These are unregulated and illegal.
Ekegusii: Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) yakureire abaKenya igoro yogotoma chibesa gochia chigurupu chiembeo bakobangaina konyora obwaita kera ewiki. Ebinto binga buna ebio tibiri bia amachiko igo nebiobong'ainereria.

English: "Public notice: DCI has shut down a fraudulent real estate company operating under multiple names in Kiambu. Always perform a search at the Lands Ministry."
Ekegusii: "Ogokurera ase bonsi": Omotuki omonene osiekire ekampani yobokengeka ogokora obokengeka bwaye goetera amarieta ao ao aaria Kiambu ekongaina abanto kobaoneria emechi yokomenya operating. Kera engaki rigia komanya obomaene bwebinto binga buna ebio korwa ofosi yamaremo."

English: Fake insurance brokers have been selling invalid motor covers in bus stations. Confirm your insurer through IRA  public registry.
Ekegusii: Abaonia bechinsuarensi boborimo babeire bakoonia ebinto bioborimo nonya nime yechirori chibasi. Manya buya ng'a einsuarensi yao nerikire gose neitabire neserikari goetera Insuaren Regulatory Authority (IRA).

English: Communications Authority has warned of fake WiFi installers operating in residential estates. Confirm service providers through the CA licensed list
Ekegusii: Communications Authority has warned of fake WiFi installers operating in residential estates. Confirm service providers through the CA licensed list

English: "We have received multiple reports of individuals faking job placement letters for Qatar and UAE. All foreign employment must go through accredited agencies."
Ekegusii: "Twanyorire chiripoti chinyinge chiabanto bagwegokora ng'a mbare namarube yemeremo gochia Qatar na UAE. Emeremo yonsi gochia chinse chia isiko goika aetere ebiombe bimanyekanete buya nabwo bagotebwa nga mbare nemeremo neserikari ya Kenya"

English: "The Ministry of ICT reminds citizens that all eCitizen payments are automated. Do not send money to personal numbers for services."
Ekegusii: "Eminisitiri yamang'ana netekinorochi yokoererania amang'ana (ICT)nkoinyoria ere abanainchi chibesa chionsi chia eCitizen nigo chigoakanwa goetera ebengi na Mpesa chimanyekanete neserikari . Tiga gotoma chibesa gochia chinamba chabanto nonya ngake."

English: "Fake humanitarian campaigns using stolen photos have been flagged on Twitter. Always verify fundraisers through trusted platforms like M-Changa or Red Cross Kenya."
Ekegusii: "Chibicha chioborimo gotumia chibicha chiabanto bande baibete korigeria chibesa chiangirwe buna okogenda mamincha yerichiko ria twiter. Kera engaki chungusa abakorigia chibesa goetra chinchera chiegenire buna M-Changa gose Omosaraba Omobaririri) Red Cross Kenya."

English: Nairobi residents, beware of people who claim to provide business loans within an hour. The government does not have such a cash-in-hand program.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi ba Nairobi, kab maiso nabanto bagwekora ng'a nkorwa bare chironi chiebiasara ase engaki yensa eyemo yoka. Eserikari tebwati moroberio onga buna eyio bwechibesa koboko chiokorwa.

English: Kenyans are warned to avoid online forex traders promising guaranteed profits. CBK does not license individuals to offer such services.
Ekegusii: Abakenya bakureirwe gwetanga koonia chibesa chiechinse ao ao goetera eintaneti abanyabiasara bakongaina abanto nga abaita obonene mboreo. Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) teri korwa erensesi as omonto oyomo gkora agasi eyio.

English: DCI cautions the public against forged university admission letters being used to defraud parents. Always verify admission directly with the institution.
Ekegusii: Omotuki omonene okureire aanainchi igoro yamarube yogosa eyunifasiti yoborimo agendererete gotimeka kongaina na koibera abaibori. Kera engaki chungusa rirube riogosoa eyunifasiti goetra uyunifasiti enyene.

English: Public warning: There are no County Government jobs offered via agents in town. Anyone asking for a facilitation fee is running a scam.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa kwa bonsi: Meremo teiyo yechikaonti okorugwa goetera abaachenti abwo emechie gose chitaoni. Onde bwensi ogosaba chibesa chiokomokonya agokorere ayio noboibi maiso marore.

English: "Communications Authority has launched a hotline for reporting impersonation scams involving fake mobile providers. Dial 0800 222 777 to report."
Ekegusii: "Ekeombe getenenerete oboererania bwamang'ana giaansire enamba ya morero gokonya koyemanyia gose abasikari igoro yabanto bagwekona nga nkorwa bare obokoreri beintaneti. Aka esimi 0800 222 777 koyemanyia amang'ana ayio."

English: "Be cautious of agents offering NHIF registration at matatu stages. Report such individuals to the nearest police post. NHIF registration is free."
Ekegusii: "Kabe maiso korwa abanto bagwekora ng'a nkorika bare ase omoroberio bweinsuarensi ya nyagitari (NHIF) abwo ase chirori chikorinerwa. Ripoti abanto abwo ase eporisi ere ange naye. Kwerika koba oyomo ase Einsuarensi ya Nyagitari (NHIF) mbosa egokorwa."

English: "The Ministry of Education reiterates that bursary forms are distributed freely and do not require payment. Any demand for money should be reported."
Ekegusii: "Eminisitiri yechisemi yabekire chinguru nga chibasari chiesukuru nigo chikorugwa bosa fnaigo tegaineirie nga oakane. Gosabwa besa chinde chionsi nere buya korwaipoti."

English: "We urge Kenyans to double-check the legitimacy of any NGO requesting donations via mobile payment. Many have been flagged for fraud."
Ekegusii: "Nigo togosaba abakenya koirorera gocheki oboamaene bwebiombe bia NGO dchigosaba ogokonya goetera entaneti. Chinyinge chiechio chianyorirwe koba echioboibi"

English: Do not give your M-PESA PIN to anyone! This is a very common scam.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa korwa epini ya M-PESA yaogochia ase onde bwensi! Eye nero enchera abange baibeirwe.

English: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all bank and social media accounts.
Ekegusii: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all bank and social media accounts.

English: Beware of emails pretending to be from banks asking for account verification.
Ekegusii: Beware of emails pretending to be from banks asking for account verification.

English: Use a strong password like 'Nairobi2023!/' that is not easy to crack.
Ekegusii: Tumia enomba yesiri enkongu okoigorera esimi yao buna Gusii2025! Eyio etari raisi ase monto onde koigora.

English: Never click on suspicious links like 'Youve won KSh 100,000!' in SMS.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kobata eraini yeintaneti orechitangutangu nero buna eria ekogotebi ng'a kwanyorire chibesa 100,000!' goetera amangana ameng'e eyesimi.

English: Update your phones software monthly to fix security vulnerabilities.
Ekegusii: Kera engaki tema gokora keboyia einchini yesimi yao kera omotienyi erio koyerenda korwa okoriegwa nebinyinyi.

English: If your child is being bullied online, report it to the DCI Cyber ​​Unit immediately!
Ekegusii: Onye omwana oo ogochandwa, kogoswa gose koramwa goetera eintaneti, manyia omonene bwobotuki otari konyorwa!

English: Avoid using public Wi-Fi for banking. Hackers can steal your data.
Ekegusii: Tiga gotumia chisimi gose eintaneti kobeka gose gotoma chibesa gochia akaonti yao yebengi. Gokora igo nigo okorwa ribaga abaibi bare nobang'aini bwogosoa eintaneti yao na gokoibera ase obowororo.

English: Teach children to avoid sharing personal details with 'online friends'.
Ekegusii: Abana batige gosanga amangana abao nabasani babo bembeo goeera eintaneti.

English: Check 'Serena_254's' profile to see if it's legit before accepting the friend request.
Ekegusii: Risegereria komanya inki 'Serena_254's' erengete nyuma otarakora kende nabarabwo.

English: Use a VPN on public networks to encrypt your internet traffic.
Ekegusii: Tumia chinamba chiesiri ekero ogosoa ase Wi-Fi yabanto bonsi erio bwerende korwa abant barengete koyetuka komanya ninki kere ime.

English: Lock SIM yako kwa *something#! Usiache mtu atumie line yako kufanya maovu.
Ekegusii: Sieka ESIM kadi yesimi yao buna *gentogete#! Totigera omonto atumie eraini yesimi yao gokora obobe

English: Fake job offers like 'Earn KSh 50k daily from home' are scams.Avoid upfront payments.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yoborimo buna Nyora chinusi chilifu 50 kera rituko korwa nka' namangana oborimo agotumeka gokora oboibi. Tiga korwa chibesa omanye konyora chibesa.

English: Monitor bank statements for unauthorized transactions weekly.
Ekegusii: Mongera buna chibesa chia chigosoa na gosoka kera ewiki ase akaonti yebengi yao erio onyare komanya bwango boibi bonde bwonsi bobaise kobao.

English: Don't write your passwords down in a book! Use an app like 'SafePass' to save them.
Ekegusii: Tiga korika ringana riao riesiri riesimi goge ebengi ase egetabu! Tumia omoroberio beintanati yao ekero okoyeigora 'SafePass' rio korenda ringana erio ria riabobisi.

English: Use biometrics (fingerprint/face ID) instead of PINs where possible.
Ekegusii: Tumia egento buna ekiara kiao gose epicha yobosio bwao rika ria enamba yesiri ase ekonyarekana.

English: Download apps only from Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
Ekegusii: Nyora ebinto biria gigokonya esimi gokora emeremo yaye goetera Google Play Store gose Apple App Store.

English: If you are using a cyber computer, log out after using your Gmail!
Ekegusii: Onye kogotumia ekombiuta yesaiba, rimia Gmail akaonti yao ekero gwakorire korora ebinto gwatagete!

English: Ignore messages like 'Youve won Safaricom Jackpot!'Theyre scams.
Ekegusii: Ombia amang'ana ameng'e esimi buna 'Kwabuire ejakipoti ya Safaricom' Aya namangana arengete gokoibera.

English: Encrypt sensitive files before sharing them online.
Ekegusii: Amanagana ao obobisi yakeborane gochia enkwana yobobisi otayarasanga ase eintaneti.

Ekegusii: Totumia enamba yesiri eyemo ase esimi, ebengi, akaonti ya Gmail, sose Facebook! Omonto aise gwesoi ase akaonti yao, onso aria kwabwate aroro nigo agosira pi na tokoyanyora rinde.

Ekegusii: Kongoria buya ebiombe biria bigosaba ogokonywa goetera eintaneti otararwa besa ende yonsi. Abarigia chibesa boborimo nao bare.

English: Install antivirus software to protect against malware and spyware.
Ekegusii: Beka egento keria kegotanga ebinyinyi ase esimi nekombiuta yao koyerenda korwa ebinyinyi bia malware na spyware.

English: Avoid 'get rich quick' schemes promising high returns.Theyre Ponzi scams.
Ekegusii: Tiga kongaineka ng'a notenke bwango' emeroberio amangana akogotebia obwaita bwa bwango. Obo noborimo.

Ekegusii: tanga abanto korwa eWi-Fi yao ya nka goetera ringana rikingu kwegia buna'Jamhuri@1963'.

English: Check for 'https://' and a padlock icon before entering payment details online.

Ekegusii: Rosia ekopi yamangana ao yengencho ase esimi goe ekombiuta gochia ekegachi kende terio gwekonya korwa ogosarigwa nebinyinyi

Ekegusii: Onye gokorigia ogokonywa korwa ekambani, tumia chinamba chiesimi gose eintaneti yekambani.

Ekegusii: Tarera chinyomba chigokomboa aye omonyene. Amangana goetera eintaneti nabo arabe oborimo.

Ekegusii: Nyora ebinto biria bigokonya esimi gose ekombiuta gokora emeremo korwa aase egenire buna Google Play gose Apple App Store.

Ekegusii: Ase chisimi bata Enable' Rigia Esimi Yane' ase chisimi erio koyebwatia ekero yasirire gose koibwa.

Ekegusii: Sambereria gose beka ase emerangwa nechitirisa ase enyoba yeekorofa ebinto bigokonya gotanga abana tibagwa inse.

Ekegusii: Totiga abana gotienera ase amagena are ekero amaagacho agendererete.

Ekegusii: Manyererania genkio nabanto benyoma yao aase ogotamera chingaki chiomobasekano.

Ekegusii: Kabe ange nabana bao ekero bakogosori nebinto biria biogokorerwa chigosori.

Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotumia ebinto biesitima bisaregete gose bigisamba.

Ekegusii: Rigereria buya rire buna rire otarasoka kogenda gose gosoka gochia esafari.

Ekegusii: Tomocha gotasieka erori yao gose gotiga ebinto biengencho kororekana ime.

Ekegusii: Beka egento keria gekonyonka embeo embe onye kogotumia amaguta etaya gose egasi.

Ekegusii: Kabe nebinto bia ntenera biranyare kogokonya ekero kiobokongu buna ekero esitima etaiyo obe etochi koreta oborabu ase eyomba, amo namasasi, na amariogo, namache okonywa.

Ekegusii: Tiga kobeka ebinto bire atari ase abana ase baranyare kobikera.

Ekegusii: Okwemanyekania aye omonyene igoro yenibo obwate bono nigo ogekorwa goetera egedichitri gose eintaneti. Segeta obokeene ase ogoikerania ayio goetera eintaneti.

English: Embrace innovation for greater impact. Ethical leadership starts with you.
Ekegusii: Bwata chinchera chinyia chiogokora emeremo ase obokoreri oboikeranu. Engencho engiya nigo egochaka naye.

English: Unified action is needed in the war against graft. Stand firm, report corruption.
Ekegusii: Okobwatera amo nkoganeirie erio gosegeta esegi ase obokorekanu. Tenena bokong'u, teba ase obokorekanu bore.

English: Search warrants are investigative tools, not criminal proceedings. Uphold the law, uphold integrity.
Ekegusii: Abasikari gocha kogotuka buna koti yabatomete nokorigia obosaiti, na tari ekina kiobosaria. Sika richiko, kabe nekeene.

English: Visit the ASK Eldoret Show and stand with us in the fight against corruption. Together we can safeguard Kenya’s future.
Ekegusii: Tarera amaorokererio yoboremi (ASK) aaria Eldoret na koba oyomo oito ase okorwania obokengeka. Amo nabo torakonye Kenya ayito aiga motwe.

English: Keep our roads safe. Corruption in licensing and inspections is “licensing to kill.” Report bribery in transport.
Ekegusii: Bwatia amachiko obogendi chirori gotanga emebasekano. Konyora erensesi yokogendi erori ase obokengeka gose eroi yao koegwa amarube yoborigereria nga mbuya ere yoborimo “nokorwa erensesi yogoita.” Teba igoro yokoria riaki ase obobogoria.

English: Join our outreach in Nandi County: raise awareness, promote ethics, and stand with us against graft.
Ekegusii: Inchuo naintwe ase ogoikera abanto isiko gokwanerana aiga ekaonti yaito ya Nandi: manyia abanto, segeta chingencho chingiya, na tenena naintwe korwania obokengeka.

English: Be cautious of strangers asking for personal or financial information.
Ekegusii: Erende korwa abanto otamanyeti bagokobori amangana igoro yao gose chibesa chiao.

English: Install window security film to make glass harder to break.
Ekegusii: Sambereria chichuma ase chetirisa chia erio gotanga ebirore tibiateka raisi.

English: Don't leave ladders or tools outside that could help burglars gain access.
