Ekegusii: Totuiga engasi gose kende gionsi keranyare gokonya abaibi korina mwao ase ekorofa na kogoikera.

English: Keep car doors locked and windows up when driving in high-risk areas.
Ekegusii: Sieka emerangu yerori yao na koyeroki buya ekero okogendia erori yao ase chirori nabanto bare abange gose obosaria bwa igoro.

English: Use tracking devices for valuable items like electronics and vehicles.
Ekegusii: Beka erori yao ebinto biria biranyare koyebwatia gose koyerora ase ere ekero yaibirwe nebinto binde bia bionsi biingencho.

English: Be wary of strangers offering unsolicited help with ATMs or banking.
Ekegusii: Eborie buya igoro tabanto otamanyeti bakorwa ogokonya kwa bosa goetera obokoreri bwechisimi, (ATMs) gose ebengi.

English: Create inventory of household items with photos and receipts for insurance.
Ekegusii: Rika inse ebinto bionsi bia mwao. biake chibicha na gacha amarisiti kwabigorerete gonya insuarensi kogoakana ekero birayie gose koibwa.

English: Use deadbolt locks on exterior doors for added security.
Ekegusii: Use deadbolt locks on exterior doors for added security.

English: Be cautious about sharing personal information on phone calls.
Ekegusii: Renda tobaise gosanga amangana ao abobisi gose ayengencho na monto onde bwensi goetera chinkwana ase esimi.

English: Install motion-activated lights in dark areas around your property.
Ekegusii: Beka ase enkna yao gose ase enibo yao ere ebirobu biesitima biria ekero biarorire omonto botuko bigwoka gokomanyia nga onto nare isiko.

English: Keep shrubbery near entry points low to maintain visibility.
Ekegusii: Simeka amaoga ase omorangwa gose egesona kiao.

English: Don't leave spare keys in obvious places like under doormats or flowerpots.
Ekegusii: Totiba ekopi yebinguo biao bia kobera aase aamo engaki entambe buna inse yomogeka bwenyomba gose ase enyongo yamaoga - bichenchie kera engaki.

English: Use security bars or grilles on vulnerable windows and doors.
Ekegusii: Sambereria egiriri ase chitirisa nemerangu gochikong'ia.

English: Be alert in parking lots - have keys ready and check backseat before entering.
Ekegusii: Be alert in parking lots - have keys ready and check backseat before entering.

English: The Police Service urges Patriotic Kenyans to report cases of illegal immigrants for arrest to the nearest police stations.
Ekegusii: Abasikari baboririe abakenya baria banhete ense yabo Kenya bamanyie igoro yabanto bakagere gosoa Kenya goetera emerangu ya magega gochia eporisi steseni ya ange babwatwe.

English: We urge citizens to cooperate with security personnel as they perform their duties and use lawful channels to address their grievances.
Ekegusii: Nigo togosaba abanainchi babweterane nabarendi boborendi chingaki bagokora emeremo yabo ase ogotumia chinchera chireo korwa okwemurunganania kwabo.

English: We urge citizens to continue volunteering information that will lead to the arrest of Francis Gaitho.
Ekegusii: Nigo togosaba abanainchi bagenderere korwa amang'ana gochia ase abasikari aranyare gokonya komobwata Francis Gaitho.

English: Let's continue playing our part in thwarting terror by sharing information on suspicious activities with relevant authorities.
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo oito atigare koba maiso nagokora ensemo yaye gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomuin goetera akomanyania amang'ana gose ebinto tore nechitangutangu nabirobio.

English: If you have information, #ReachDCI through hotline number 0800 722 203. Let's work together to uphold justice and accountability. #FichuaGaitho
Ekegusii: Onye kore nering'ana, #Moikera omotuki omonene goetera enamba ya morero 0800 722 203. Tiga tokore emeremo amo gosegeta ekeene nobotenereri obuya. #Bisora Gaitho

English: The public is advised to exercise restrain and is explicitly cautioned against any attempts to enter without authorisation or break into JKIA as it is a protected zone under the laws of Kenya.
Ekegusii: Abanto basemiigwe gwetanga koba nobororo na gokurerwa kegima ng'a tibatema kobuna egeita na gosoa nechinguru egetii kene giechindege gia Jomo Kennyatta International Airport (JKIA) egekogera aiga naase arendire nerichiko ria Kenya.

English: Youths are advised to reject alshabaab propaganda to avoid premature death or such hefty jail sentences.
Ekegusii: Abasae basemiigwe kwanga amangana alshabaab aporopaganda gotanga ogokwa kwabwango buna etarenge engencho yogokwa gose gosibwa echera engaki entambe.

English: Citizens are advised to avoid buying phones from random people as Telcos and Security Agencies are tracking the stolen devices.
Ekegusii: Abanainchi basemiigwe gotanga gotaboria chisimi korwa ase abantoekiageraekambani eria yarosetie chisimi echio nabasikari nkobwatia bare chisimi chibire.

English: Let's work with Police to arrest criminals hiding in #Maandamano to steal, destroy properties and commit other crimes.
Ekegusii: Tiga tokore emeremo amo nabasikari kobwata ebibago biebisete ase amaanadamano erio koiba, dgosaria ebinto kobakora abande koba ebibago.

English: Let's avoid sharing propaganda, unverified information, and graphic images in order not to add to the distress of the affected.
Ekegusii: Totige korandarandia amangana yoborimo, amangana ataramanyekana boronge, amo nechibicha erio titoba abakogesa obororo ase baria bare nobokong'u.

English: Citizens are advised to conduct themselves in a lawful manner. All acts of sabotage, theft and incitement will be prosecuted.
Ekegusii: Abanainchi basabirwe koba abatebere na abasigete richiko. Ebikoru biobosaria biabomwenu, oboibi na gosegeta abanto kobuna amchiko goika agambigwe.

English: Disturbance of peace, incitement, looting, and vandalism remain unlawful.
Ekegusii: Ogoturubania omorembe, ogosegeta abanto, okiba, na gosaria ebinto nigo bire mamincha yerichiko.

English: Verify identity of delivery personnel before allowing access to property.
Ekegusii: Rigereria buya ekabande kiomonto ogokoba gose korenta ebinto buya nyuma otaramwanchera gosoa.

English: Don't leave valuables visible in your car when parked.
Ekegusii: Totiga ebinto biengencho birorekane ime yerori yao ekero oyeteneneties ase chirori chikobekwa.

English: Use steering wheel locks as additional deterrent for vehicle theft.
Ekegusii: Sieka gose richania egento keria kierori omorundia erori agotumia goonchorana amagoro gakoyegendi (Obureki) buna enchera eyo yogotanga teibwa.

English: Be cautious of 'distraction theft' tactics in public places.
Ekegusii: Tigara komanyete buna abaibi chingencho abaibi bagotumia ase abanto bare abange koiba.

English: Keep emergency numbers visible near phones and programmed in mobile devices.
Ekegusii: Rika na kobeka chinamba chiesimi ase chikororekana buya mbarabare nesimi yao echio chirangerigwe ekero kiomobaseka konyora obokonyi visible.

English: Consider installing a safe for important documents and valuables.
Ekegusii: Nere buya koba nase agiya okobeka amanag'ana ao na ebinto biaobiengencho.

English: Be wary of 'emergency' scams where callers pretend to be family in distress.
Ekegusii: Kabe maiso nechisimi korwa ase abanto bagwekona buna abamo babamino chigokorangeria nga omonto omino nare ase emechando eganetie oboknyi bwa bwango gokonya obogima bwaya.

English: Use security chains on doors even when expecting visitors.
Ekegusii: Sieka emerangu yao yenyomba nenyororo nonya nekero okagerete abageni gocha kogokwania.

English: Don't leave purses or wallets unattended in shopping carts or public places.
Ekegusii: Tiga gotiga ebibeti biechibesa bitarendiri na monto ase eduka, echiro gose aande onsi.

English: Be cautious of 'shoulder surfing' at ATMs and when entering PINs.
Ekegusii: kabe maiso ase emachini eria ekorusia chibesa ase ebengi na abanto bakoigoka ang'e okobata PIN emachine ekoe chibesa.

English: Use security cameras with cloud storage to preserve evidence if needed.
Ekegusii: Beka chikamera chiria chibwatanirie neintaneti chikobwata abanto buna bagosoa na gosoka gose ebinto bigendererete kogonya obosaiti ekero boganeirie.

English: Usifanye maonyesho ya mali thamani kwa umma - weka kwa siri na salama.
Ekegusii: Tobaise kworokia enibo yao ore nero ase abanto- yegache ase obobisi na buya.

English: Install security film on glass doors to prevent easy break-ins.
Ekegusii: Beka egamu gatigati yebirore bierori yao gotanga abaibi kobwata ase obwororo.

English: Put unique marks on your belongings to easily identify them if they are stolen.
Ekegusii: Beka ekemayererio kia beene ase ebinto biao erio onyare kobiatanana buya ekero biabirwe.

English: Keep car registration and insurance documents secure, not in glove compartment.
Ekegusii: Gacha amasakara kwagorerete erori yao amo neinsuarensi kafa yerori yao ase agaya , na tari ase erori yao ome.

English: Be cautious of 'too good to be true' offers for rentals or purchases.
Ekegusii: Kabe maiso nebinto bikororekana buya na buna ebiekeene bikorugwa ogore enyomba aase gete.

English: Don't leave doors and windows open at night, even if it's very hot.
Ekegusii: Tobaise gotiga omorangu gose etirisa bitasiekirie botuko, nonya riberera rire rinene.

English: Consider joining or forming a business watch program in commercial areas.
Ekegusii: Nere buya kobwatana nabanyabiasara ase oborendi bwebiasara biano aaria ase ebiasara.

English: Contact emergency services through: Police (999), DCI (0800 722 203).
Ekegusii: Ikera ogokonywa chingaki chiemebasekano goetera: Porisi (999), Omotuki omonene (0800 722 203).

English: Be cautious of strangers asking to use your phone for 'emergencies'.
Ekegusii: Erende nabanto otamanyeti bakogosaba esimi yao baake ase ingana rinde rionsi riomobasekano'.

English: UNDP feature on community policing, Nyumba Kumi and Youth liaison programs in Kenya
Ekegusii: Obomo bwechinse chikwegambera nemeroberio yamagenderero (UNDP) nkworokereria ere igoro yabarendi boborendi (Community Policing), Nyumba Kumi amo nemeroberio yogoikera abasae (Youth liaison programs) aiga Kenya

English: Police Reforms Working Group calls for stronger COP
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia baria bagokora amaonchorerio ase obokoreri bwabasikari nigo kegosaba ogokongigwa kwa abarendi boborendi (COP)

English: Study report on Nyumba Kumi impacts in Migori County (Suna West)
Ekegusii: Eripoti ya ayarorekanete goikerwa naobokoreri bwa Nyumba Kumi aaria ekaonti ya Migori (Suna West).

English: KIPPRA analysis of community policing reforms
Ekegusii: Obokongoria bwa KIPPRA igoro yamaonchorerio igoro yabarendi boborendi.

English: Nairobi informal settlements community policing case study with relevance to wider Nakuru experience.
Ekegusii: Ayanyorekanete arengete abarendi boborendi ase emechie yechirandi aaria Nairobikoreng'ana na ayare aaria Nakuru engima.

English: Community policing committees model in Narumoru station (serving Nyeri County), supported by IMLU, engaging community officers
Ekegusii: Engencho engiya yechikomiti chia abarendi boborendi aaria omochie o'Narumoru station (Obokoreri bwakaonti ya Nyeri), bwasiretwe na IMLU, kobwaterana nabarai bebinyoro.

English: IMLU report on community policing committees in Narumoru (serving Nyeri and Nyandarua region)
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia IMLU kiarure eripoti igoro yechikomoti chiabarendi boborendi aaria Narumoru (egokorera ensemo ya Nyandarua)

English: Mombasa community policing forum convened by KEPSSI and local leaders to curb juvenile gangs in Likoni
Ekegusii: Ogocha amo kwabarendi boborendi aaria ekaonti ya Mombasa gwakoretwe nekeombe keria kiobomo bwechisukuru chioboroso  (KEPSSI) ase okobwaterana nabarai bebinyoro gokinana na ebiombe biobosaria nabana abake aaria Likoni

English: Research showing how police community collaboration contributed to crime reduction in Machakos Sub County
Ekegusii: Obotuki bokoorokia buna okobwaterana gwe ekenyoro na eserekari biorokiri gokei obosaria

English: Academic findings on drivers of COP success and constraints in Migori County's Nyumba Kumi program
Ekegusii: Amasomo abeene aorokirie buna omosangerekano bwabasangi ase oborendi (COP) bwakonyire gokeania emechando aaria ekaonti ya Migori goetera omoroberio O'Nyumba Kumi.

English: Outline of training programs for police and community defenders in Kisumu, Mombasa, Nakuru, prior to national elections
Ekegusii: Ngwatora ere emeroberio yokwegeria as abasikari nabaegereri bebinyoro aaria Kisumu, Mombasa amo na' Nakuru ange nobochori obonene.

English: All 47 Kenyan county security committee members received training in community policing and prevention of violent extremism
Ekegusii: Abarendi boborendi bechikaonti chionsi 47 mbanyorete amasomo amao nabateneneri boborendi bebinyoro abanyene gotanga obosareki bwogoonchorwa ebirengererio.

English: TOday GBV-capacity workshop with NPS and community figures across Kisumu subcounties
Ekegusii: Rero ogomomia gokinia okomanya igoro yogokorera bobe abande ase yeki bare ase abasikari nabanto bande bebinyoro basikire ase amechie emeke yonsi inse ye'kaonti ya Kisumu

English: KNCHR tells of citizen engagement programs boosting security and human rights awareness in Kisumu County
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gia Kenya kerendete oboronge bwa mwanyabanto (KNCHR) ngoteba bare igoro yemeroberio yokobwaterana buna yakong'irie oborendi na obomanyi igoro yoboronge bwa mwanayabanto aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu

English: NPS published an official Text for community policing roles and expectations to help residents and officers work together more effectively
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekekene kiabasikari (NPS) ngiatomete amanga amen'ge gochia abarendi boborendi bwebinyoro goetera esimi kobamanyia emeremo yabo nekere gekageire korwa asebare gokonya abamenyi na abaofisa gokora emeromo amo keboikeranu.

English: Study demonstrates that adoption of community policing in Nairobi significantly improves service delivery and police accountability
Ekegusii: Amasomo aorokirie ng'a goitabwa kwoborendi bwenyoro nabanyene aaria Nairobi yakonyire kegima emeremo yokorwa oborendi ase oboikeranu.

English: NPS published a Text detailing roles and expectations of community policing in Nairobi County
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene ki'abasikari nkiarigete amangana ameng'e agoteba buya emeremo na egekageire korwa abarendi boborndi bwebinyo ase ekaonti ya Nairobi.

English: Research shows that community policing in Nairobi County significantly improves service delivery in police stations
Ekegusii: Amasomo yokorigia chisemi chinyia nkworokia are ng'a abarendi boborendi bwenyoro ase ekaonti ya Nairobi ogoonchoreria okonene buna egasi egokorwa yoborendi ase chisitesheni chia police.

English: Citywide COP strategy building citizen coalitions for crime prevention in Nairobi City
Ekegusii: Chinchera chibarendi boborendi bwenyoro Nairobi engima (COP) bagoetera gocha amo nakorosia ebiombe bioboamo gotanga obosaria omochie omonene o'Nairobi.

English: NCRC government report finds mixed public trust in police despite years of community policing
Ekegusii: Chiripoti chiekeombe ekenene gieserikari ekio kebwata chiripoti chieserikari chionsi (NCRC) nkworokia kere chitang'utang'u gati yabanainchi buna okwegena kwabo ase abasikari kore ogoke nonya yabeire engaki entambe korwa omoroberio bwoborendi nabarendi bebinyoro ochagete.

English: Analysis of police social media use and public trust dynamics in Nairobi City County
Ekegusii: Okounenkia kwabasikari buna ebinto biokomanyia amang'ana (NCRC) bagotumeka na buna abainainchi babegenete ase ekaonti yomochi omonene bwekaonti ya Nairobi.

English: NCRC report reveals while community policing increased info sharing public trust remains low in Nairobi County
Ekegusii: Chiripoti chiekeombe keria ekenene getenerete amasomo yobosaria (NCRC) yaorokirie ng'a nonya abarendi boborendi bwenyoro bagesete okomanyania amang'ana okwegenwa kwabo ase abainchi nogo kore inse ase ekaonti ya Nairobi.

English: NCRC survey shows Kenyans want COP to tackle drug abuse, professionalism and slow investigations
Ekegusii: Obokongoria bwekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korigia chisemi chinyia chiogotanga obosaria (NCRC) nigo bookorokia ng'a abanto ba Kenya mbatagerte omonene otenerete obokoreri bwasikari (COP) akore omochando bwogotumia bobe amarigo nebinto biogotindia ase obotuki bwa bwango.

English: NPS urged by IPOA and oversight bodies to strengthen community policing to improve public trust
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kia abasikari NPS giasoroirwe nekeombe keria getenerete abasikari bonsi (IPOA) na bonsi baria bakorigereria emeremo yabasikari bae abarendi boborendi bwenyiro chunguru buna enchera eyemo yokoirania okwegena.

English: Interior Ministry commits to implement police reform proposals including expanded COP structures
Ekegusii: Eministry yoborendi bwa ime yaenekirie gokora oboonchoreria bwa amachiko emeremo yabasikari buna ebirengererio biarwetwe na kogarei obokoreri bweofisi yomosikari oria otenenerete emeremo yabasikari (COP).

English: New community policing head Judy Jebet appointed to lead COP efforts in Nairobi County
Ekegusii: Omorai omonene omoyia bwabarendi bwoborendi bwenyoro Judy Jebet obekirwe koba omorai omonene otenenerete obokori emereyo yabasikari (COP) bwekaonti ya Nairobi.

English: UoN report assesses trust dynamics and communication as key to successful COP in Ruai portion of Nairobi
Ekegusii: Eripoti yeyunifasiti ya Nairobi (UoN) yarengete ayarengete obwegenu na oboererania bwamangana buna obwengencho enene goikerania obokoreri bwabasikari (COP) aaria ensemo ya Ruai ya Nairobi.

English: University of Nairobi research shows strong positive link between COP strategies and crime reduction in Machakos SubCounty
Ekegusii: Obokongoria bweyunifasiti ya Nairobi Nairobi mbwaorogetie emeroberio yokobwateterana kwabeene gati yomoteneneri omonene bwegasi yabasikari (COP) buna yakeanirie obosaria ase emechie ameke yekaonti ya Machakos

English: Police presence and roadblocks set up in Machakos ahead of youth-driven Nane Nane protests as part of COP and crowd management readiness
Ekegusii: Obonge bwabasikari nebirichanio biechipara biabekirwe Machakos nyuma yokororobekana kwabasae kwa Nane Nane erio gokinana nabarabwo buna omoroberio (COP) ase ogokinana na abanto abnge.

English: Arrest in Yatta neighborhood achieved after public tip-off about robberies example of citizen-police collaboration
Ekegusii: Okobwatwa kwebibago aaria ase emate ya Yatta nogo kwanyarekanete nyuma yabainchi korwa korwa amang'ana gochia ase abasikari buna enchera eyemo yabainchi kobwaterana nabasikari

English: Regional police launch COP-informed operations profiling gangs and increasing patrols in Kisumu County
Ekegusii: Abarai babateneneri bwokoreri bwabasikari bechingo babekirwe goikerani obokoreri obuya ase okomanya abasaria ba kera engencho nagotoma abasikari gochia ase ayio aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu.

English: Interior CS opens new Kasagam police station enhancing security and COP infrastructure in Kisumu East
Ekegusii: Omonimisita bwoborendi bwa ime oigoire egetaseni gia porisi enyia ya Kasagam kogesa oborendi nobokoreri bwa baria batenenerete abasikari buna bagokora emeremo yabo aaria Kisumu ya mocha.

English: IOM-supported COP public engagement events bring communities and security agencies together in Garissa
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giense getenerete gokongia obokoreri bweserikari (IOM) giakonyire gosira abanene babasikari gokora emeremo yabo ase okobwaterana gokora emeremo yabo amo nabainchi aaria Garissa.

English: Stakeholders including police chiefs and counselors trained in GBV community policing and awareness in Kisumu County
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi amo nabasikari na baria bonsi batagegete oborendi amo nabasemia basomiigwe igoro komanyia abanto igoro yobobe bwogochaya gose gokorera abande bobe ase enncho yeki bare aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu

English: NPS published its official Community Policing Information Booklet to clarify roles, expectations and citizen engagement frameworks
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) nkiarwete egetabu kebwate eripoti igoro yoborendi bwebinyoro erio kobamanyia buna babwenerete gokora emeremo yabo, eke gekageire korwa ase bare bokobwaterana nabanyabinyoro.

English: Kenya Methodist University/IJRISS research shows community policing significantly improves service delivery and trust in Nairobi County
Ekegusii: Eyunifasiti ya Kenya Methodist University kobwaterana na nechiyunfasiti chinde igoro yokorigia chisemi chinyia igoro yobobwenia nabanto korwa Belgium (IJRISS) yaorogetie ng'a oborendi bwebinyoro nobwengencho ase okorwa oborendi bwokwegena aaria ekaonti ya Nairobi.

English: University of Nairobi research identifies communication as key to community trust and COP effectiveness in Ruai Township
Ekegusii: Eyunifasiti ya Nairobi ekorigia chisemi chinyia yaorogetie nga ogokwanerana bun egento kiengencho koreta obwegenwa ase ebinyoro na okobwtera nebinyoro korwa oborendi (COP) ase oboikeranu aria etaoni enke ya Ruai.

English: Nairobi Regional Commander pledges safe policing of GenZ protests incorporating COP principles and coordination with community groups
Ekegusii: Omosikari omonene bworogongo rwa Nairobi oenekeirie abasae ba GenZ oborendi ekero giokorobererekana kwabo bobwateranete nokobwaterana nobwebinyoro kobarenda inse yemeroberio ya (COP) ase okoererania nebinyoro.

English: Police credit community policing efforts for a marked decline in murders, defilement and other serious crimes in Mwala Machakos County
Ekegusii: Abasikari baitabire oborendo bwebinyoro ase ogokeie obosareku bwogoita, gotibonga na amamocho ande amabe aaria ekaonti ya Mwala Machakos.

English: Community forums sponsored by IOM improved trust and intelligence sharing between residents and security.
Ekegusii: Emesangerekano yebinyoro yasiretwe nekeombe giense igoro yobonganyi (IOM) yasegetete okwegenana na gosanga amang'ana obotuki gati ya abanto bebinyoro nabarendi boborendi.

English: The Inspector General pledged to implement IPOA recommendations to strengthen oversight, disciplinary processes, and responsiveness to misconduct complaints.
Ekegusii: Omorai omonene bwasikari (IG) nriete eira goikerania okoboria gwekeombe keria gietenerete korora buna abasikari bagokora emeremo yabo (IPOA) erio gokong'ia obomongeria, nchera yokorwa egesusuro, na koiraneria bwango gochia okwemuranganania kwa abanainchi.

English: A report documented systemic excessive force during protests and called for prosecutions, crowd control reforms, and stronger conduct enforcement mechanisms.
Ekegusii: Eripoti yarekoorokia buna abasikari bagotumia chinguru chinyinge ekero abanto bakorobererekana na ekaboria ng'a egosoerwa, amaonchorerio igoro buna abakorobererekana bakorendwa, nenchera ebwenerete kobarenda bikorwe.

English: Advocacy group PRWG urged criminal responsibility for senior commanders whose subordinates commit misconduct and expansion of command responsibility doctrine.
Ekegusii: Ebiombe bwabarwanereri bia abasikari baria batenerete korigia amaonchorerio (PRWG) mbamanyetie abanene ba abasikari kobogoria amamocho abasikari babo abwo bakomocha ase chigasi chiabo goetera oggochoreria amachiko as ayio.

English: The Kenya Human Rights Commission criticized the IG for bypassing the Police Service Commission’s authority, warning that it undermines constitutional oversight.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oboronge bwamwanyabanto (KNCHR) mbangete ebikoru bwomonene bwabasikari kogenda mamincha namachiko yobokoreri bwekeombe getenerete obokoreri bwabasikari, komokurera ng'a ebikoru biaye nigo bire mamincha nobomongeria.

English: Media highlighted calls for an independent investigation into a custodial death, with families demanding prosecution and better detention oversight.
Ekegusii: Ebiombo biokomanyia abanto amangana mbiaboretie nga obotuki bwogwetenera bokorwe igoro yogokwa yabanto baria barenge eseri ya porisi, abowo ase baria bakweretwe nabamwabo nga abasikari basoerwe na buna baria bare ase chiseri chia porisi bakoreretwe gose barendire.

English: An NGO launched a citizen oversight toolkit with training materials and reporting templates to strengthen youth involvement in accountability.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gie NGO yarwete egetabu kiomoroberio bwo'bomongeri bwabainchi nebinto bwokwegeria na buna babwenerete korwa amang'ana gochia erio gokongia abasae komanya na gotenerera ebikoru biabo.

English: Judicial leadership endorsed IPOA’s mandate and pledged support for stronger cooperation between the judiciary and the oversight body.
Ekegusii: Abatenereri bokogamba ebina mbaete okoboko ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) buna kegokora emeremo na koenekia kobasira ase okobwaterana gti yechikoti nebiombe biria bikomongera obokoreri bwabo.

English: IPOA launched a toll-free hotline operating 24/7 for public reporting of misconduct to increase accessibility and transparency.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) giansete esimi ya bosa ogoaka kobamanyia kobamanyia buna abasikari bakomocha ase emeremo yabo egokora emeremo amatuko onsi chinsa chionsi erio gokinia ogoikera obokoreri bwaporisi maiso marore.

English: A formal agreement between IPOA and the Law Society of Kenya aimed to streamline legal responses and improve prosecution support.
Ekegusii: Okoigwana kwabeene gati yekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) na ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete obogambi ebina namachiko gia Kenya kwarengete kobeka buya obokoreri bwamachiko na korongei na gosira buna ebina bigosou.

English: A review detailed IPOA’s achievements, challenges, and strategic direction and outlined next steps in police accountability reform.
Ekegusii: Okorigereria keboyia ngwatebe geikaranu buna ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) giakorire buya, emechamndo ereo, amo nemeroberio yabeene yar koorokia ebitambokero bia motwe biogoikerania abasikari gotenera ebikotu biegasi yabo.

English: Following an IPOA probe, a senior officer and colleague were charged with torture and abuse of office, demonstrating judicial follow-through.
Ekegusii: Goetra obotuki bwe'keombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA), omosikari omonene nomoke oye mbasoeretwe na gokumerwa igoro yogochanda gose komosuna omonto kare eseri ya porisi buna amamocho yogotumia amadaraka abo bobe, ekoenekia buna ekoti ekomongera amashitaka buya.

English: A court verdict held a police sergeant accountable in a fatal shooting case, setting precedent for misconduct prosecutions.
Ekegusii: Ekoti yanacherete omosikari omonene kobogori amamocho ase ekina giokorasa, kworokia buya buna amchiko agokora emeremo ase bonsi.

English: A legal ruling confirmed IPOA’s exclusive authority to investigate police misconduct and rejected attempts to limit its jurisdiction.
Ekegusii: Okonacha gwekoti nkwaete ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) chinguru chiogotuka buna abasikari bagokora bobe na kwanga ogosaba ng'a chinguru chiabo chikeanigwe.

English: IPOA spotlighted a serious misconduct case in Mombasa, calling for transparency and systemic discipline reforms.
Ekegusii: Ekoti ekanacha ekina ng'a ekeombe keri gietenenerete korigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo (IPOA) nkere nokobua koringori amamocho abasikari bakora igo ekanga ogosabang'a chinguru chiabochi keanigwe.

English: IPOA issued updates on detainee fatality investigations and outlined measures to improve custodial conditions.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gietenerete korigereria buna abasikariba gokora emeremo yabo (IPOA) nkiarwete eripoti yobotuki bwabo igoro yabaria babegetwe chiseri na buna baumiete amo nemeroberio yokorora ng’a baria bonsi babwatetwe mbaegwe obosibore bwabo ime yechiseri.

English: A judicial ruling found former officers guilty of murder, reinforcing accountability for serious misconduct.
Ekegusii: Ekoti yanyorete abasikari namamocho yogoita, egekoro kiabegete chinguru gokora emeremo buya gwanchereria gotaiyo goikerania korora ng’a kera omosikari ebogorerie emeremo yaye.

English: An IPOA warning stated that silence within the police force enables impunity and called for cultural reforms and safe reporting.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa korwa ekeombe keria gietenerete korigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo yabo (IPOA)ngwatebete ng’a ogotakwana buna abasikari bagokora bobe nenchera eyemo yagerire abasikari bagendererete gokora amamocho na gotegwa egesusuro, nagosaba ng’a oboonchoreria goetera chinchera chiegenka kobe erio korwa ribaga abanto koripoti.

English: IPOA inspected forensic labs and case files to improve evidence integrity and transparency in criminal investigations.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gietenerete korigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo yabo (IPOA) nkiarogereretie buya chifaeri chiebina goikerania oboikeranu bwebinto bikworokia buna amagoso arenge ase enchera yamaiso marore ase obotuki bwebina.

English: A multi-agency forum aligned civil society, oversight bodies, and government to develop a coordinated police reform strategy.
Ekegusii: Okobwaterana kwebiombe biechi-enichio (NGOs), baria bakomongera, amo nesirikari korosia amo omoroberio bwokoererania ase okoererania kwa’maonchorerio a porsi.

English: A public forum in Kakamega enabled citizens to report misconduct directly to officials, strengthening community oversight.
Ekegusii: Omosangerekano obonsi aaria Kakamega okonyire abanainchi komanyia abane gotyaertera monto onde igoro yogokora bobe kwabasikari gochia abanene, naigo yakonya kwororobia gokora emeremo.

English: An audit exposed misuse of public funds in police operations and prompted calls for fiscal transparency and procurement reform.
Ekegusii: Obokongoria mbwaorokia maiso marore igoro yogotumia chibesa bobe ekero abasikari bagokora emesako ekio kiagerete abanto gotaka komanya obokeene na obomaiso marore ase ogotumia chibesa echio na amaochorerio yobogori.

English: A live radio program educated listeners on detainee rights, proper custody treatment, and legal recourse for abuse.
Ekegusii: Amasomo goetera eredio nasomitie abategereri oborionge bwabaria bare chiseri chia polisi, buna babwenerete korendwa buya ime yeseri, na ekibaranyare gokora onye bakorereirwe bobe.

English: Posters distributed nationwide explained suspects’ rights, legal search limits, and how to file complaints with oversight bodies.
Ekegusii: Ebinto bwabwate amariko are komanyia oboronge bwomokagerwa, ekerngo giokomotababa, na buna oranyare gosoera abasikari gochia ase baria bakomongera buna abasikari bagokora emeremo.

English: NPS launched an online portal providing access to oversight reports, misconduct statistics, complaint status, and disciplinary actions.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kiabasikari (NPS) giansire obokoreri bweintaneti goikera chiripoti chia’ bamongeri buna poilisibagokora emeremo yabo barenge bakorore mamincha, buna ayio agendererete korigererigwa, negeusuro kiarurwe.

English: APS introduced a yellow card system allowing citizens to report misconduct anonymously during patrols.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gis abasikari bobokoreri (APS) mnkiarwete ekadi yerangi yomochununu buna enchera yogokonya abanainchi komanyia amamocho abasikari bagokora gotemanyekania naye ng'o chingaki bagora omosako.

English: Mombasa County launched a text-based reporting line for victims to send secure complaints to oversight officials.
Ekegusii: Ekaonti ya Mmobasa yaansete okomanyia gooetera rirube erieng'e riesimi ase baria bakoreirwe bobe gotoma ebirero biabo gochia abatenereri babasikari kobwatia amamocho ayio.

English: DCI urged citizens to submit crime complaints or tips directly to DCI offices or email to improve investigative response.
Ekegusii: Omosikari omonene bwobotuki (DCI) osoroire abanainchi babe bagotoma okwemurangania kwabo gose bosemia konde gwonsi gochia asare ere omonyene gose komotomera eimeiri erio kwangoyia obotuki nokoiraneria.

English: Guidance provided on how to file police misconduct complaints and the rights of complainants.
Ekegusii: Oborai borure buna obwenerete komanyia abatenereri babasikari buna bagokora bobe gose okwemuranganania amo noboronge bwoyokwemuranganania.

English: NPS refuted a false terror alert online and urged verification through official channels.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) mbangete amangana oborimo igoro yokobamanyia obokebago goetera eintaneti, na bagasorora ng'a koenekia amangana ayio nere buya akoreke goetera chichera chiria chireo chiokobamanyia.

English: US Embassy warned citizens of increased terror threats at tourist sites and advised heightened awareness.
Ekegusii: Obobarosi bwa America Kenya (US Embassy) mbwaruete ogokurera gochia abainchi igoro yokogeseka kwobwoba nokogosereria kwobokebago ase chioteri chiria abageni korwa chinse chi isko bakobera na korwa ogosemia buna berure komanyia ayio.

English: Authorities warned Western and Nyanza communities of suspected terror recruitment and urged reporting of suspicious behavior.
Ekegusii: Aabarai mbakurerete ebinyoro bia Mocha na Nyanza igoro yogosoigwa ase obokebago bwogoaka chipomu na gosororwa komanyia abagambi igoro ya kende gionsi giechitang'utang'u.

English: Public informed of an Al-Shabaab attack in Garissa and encouraged to stay vigilant as security heightened.
Ekegusii: Abanainchi bamanyiigwe igoro yebikoreri bia akili bandia Al bia -Shabaab goaka epomu Garissa, na kobaa omoyo gotigara maiso ekiagera oborendi bwagesirwe.

English: Security operations intensified in Kitale and North Rift to combat cattle rustling with specialized units deployed.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio yoborendi aaria Kitale na North Rift bangangane gokora aboibi bwechiombe ase okobwaterana nebitengo bieserikari bia beene biatomirwe aroro.

English: Government recognized GBV as a national security threat and called for inter‑agency collaboration.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yarorire ogkorerwa bobe ekiagera eki ore (GBV) koba ringana rokogosereria eborendi bwense na koreta amo ebitengo bieserikari kobwaterana.

English: A terror cell in Lamu was dismantled and suspects arrested in a joint security operation.
Ekegusii: Eseri ase ebibago biechipomu bibekire aaria Lamu yabunetwe na abakagerwa mbabwatetwe goetera ebitengo ao ao bieserikari.

English: NPS debunked a fake terror warning poster and cautioned against misinformation.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gia abasikari (NPS) nkiarwete oboene igoro yongainereri goetera amariko ogokurera anantetigwe chinaysi bwogoakwa epomu na gokurera abanto batige korwa amangana agotantania.

English: US Embassy issued advisory warning of heightened crime and terror risks and urged caution.
Ekegusii: Obobalosi bwa America (US Embassy) aiga Kenya yarwete ogosemia kwogokurera igoro yobosareku bwaigoro mono nokonyarekana kwobokebago na gosaba koba maiso.

English: US Embassy imposed travel restrictions for staff in six counties due to insecurity.
Ekegusii: Obobalosi bwa America (US Embassy) aiga Kenya mbwarwete ogokurera gochia abanto babo koba maiso gotarera chikaonti 6 aiga Kenya ekiagera oborendi botaisaine aroro.

English: NPS published a list of most wanted terror suspects and urged anonymous public reporting.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) nkiarwete omoroberio obaria baganeirie mono buna ebibago biogoaka chipomu na gosaba abanto babamanyie bakagerwa bande bateri gweteba barabwo mbarabi .

English: KAA heightened airport security after a bomb threat and advised early arrival for screening.
Ekegusii: Egetii giechindege kia Kenya (KAA) kiagesire oborendi ase egetii nyuma yobwoba bweombu goateka na gosaba baria bonsi bagochia koiruruka baike mapema gokorerwa oboringori.

English: US government advised citizens to avoid Eastleigh and Kibera due to security concerns.
Ekegusii: Eserikari ya America yasemirie abanainchi koba maiso gochia Eastleigh na Kibera ase engencho yoborendi botari oboikeranu.

English: Additional personnel were deployed to Naivasha to secure the Safari Rally event.
Ekegusii: Abakori emeremo abange batomirwe gochia Naivasha kobeka oborendi ekero gia Safari Rally event.

English: Public advised not to circulate graphic images after the DusitD2 attack to protect victims’ dignity.
Ekegusii: Abanainchi basabirwe tibasiarera chibicha chiokwoboi buna DusitD2 yaagetwe ebomu erio korenda amasikani ya baria baagetwe nepomu.

English: Cyclone Hidaya alert issued urging coastal residents to prepare for strong winds and floods.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa igoro ya yomorindo omonene okorokwa Hidaya kwarwetwe gosorora abanto bamenyete ang'e na nyancha ukwearigania ase emerindo emene netoigo.

English: Interior Ministry warned ahead of protests, urging peaceful demonstrations and placing security forces on alert.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoboredi bwa ime yakurerwe nyuma yokoroberekana gotaraba, egosorora nga okoroberekana kobe okwomorembe na kobeka ebitengo bionsi bioborendi maiso.

English: National Cybersecurity Strategy published outlining plans to protect digital infrastructure.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio omonene bweserikari okorenda amang'ana aye arikire taminchoria gochia amaboko amabe nkiarurwete omoroberio buna ekorenda bionsi biria bigachete amang'ana.

English: Multiple suspects arrested in Lamu during a counter‑terror operation; public urged to report tips.
Ekegusii: Abakagerwa bobosaria ba kera engencho mbabwatetwe aaria lamu ekero kiomosako gotana ogoakwa nechipomu; abanainchi mbasabetwe koerwa chiripoti.

English: Residents in flood and conflict‑prone areas ordered to evacuate with routes and shelters listed.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi bari bare aase emegoko gose aregire chimanano bachikirwe kong'anya korwa ase ande onsi ararete emechando gochia ase atebire neserikari gose chinyomba chiria eserikariyatebire.

English: Government issued updates on North Rift anti‑bandit operations and reaffirmed commitment to security.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yarure eriport igoro ya yebitengo bieserikari gotanga aboibi bwechiombe aaria North Rift na kobaenekeria oborendi bwabo.

English: NPS reminded officers to avoid misuse of force during protests and maintain professionalism.
Ekegusii: Ekombe keria ekenene gia abasikari (NPS) kiainyoirie abobisa baye gotatumia chibunduki bobe chingaki chiokoroberekana na goikerania obokoreri emeremo obuya.

English: US Embassy warned of potential unrest during primaries and urged citizens to avoid large gatherings.
Ekegusii: Obobalosi bwa America aiga Kenya US Embassy) nyarwete ogokurera igoro yomoburakano ekero gwokorwanererera chitigiti chiebiama biegesiaia igo gosaba abanainchi berende gotaba ase emesangerekano emenene.

English: Government declared a nationwide high-alert and urged citizens to remain calm, report suspicious activity, and cooperate with security agencies.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yatangasire koba maiso ense engima na gosaba abanainchi koba abatoreru, korwa eripoti igoro ya ebire nechitang'utang'u, na kobwaterana nabateneneri bobosrendi.

English: NPS warned the public about a fake police recruitment advert online and advised job seekers to rely only on official government platforms.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) giakureire abainchi igoro yokong'ainwa goetera eintaneti ng'a abasikari nkorikwa bare na kobamanyia bonsi ng'a ogotangasa gwokorika abasikari ngoetera eintaneti yeserikari yoka.

English: NPS dismissed a viral terror-warning poster as a hoax and urged the public to verify information before sharing.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) yakanete amangana igoro yokogosereria goetera eintaneti ng'a ebibago ngoaka biarenge epomu na gosaba abainchi koenekia amangana aya ase aruwete nyuma batarasareria.

English: APS responded to a school bomb threat by evacuating students, securing the area, and launching investigations into the source.
Ekegusii: Abasikari bobokoreri (APS) nkiairaneretie bwango igoro yamang'ana yokogosereria gwepombu ase esukuru goetera ogotamia abana, goetanana ase ayio, na goansa obotuki komanya ase amangana ayio arwete.

English: A curfew was imposed in Mandera County to address rising insecurity and facilitate ongoing security operations.
Ekegusii: Ogochika gotanga abanto mbasoka korwa chinka chiabo chinsa gete nkwabegetwe aaria ekaonti ya Mandera buna enchera eyemo yogokeania obokebago na kobeka oborendi ase omoroberio bwokogenderera.

English: Kenya Meteorological Department issued a flash-flood advisory for seven counties and urged residents to take safety precautions.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigeria rire buna rire nkiarwete ogkurera igoro yogocha kwembura enyinge nemegoko ime yechikaonti 7 naigo koboria abanto ng'a berende.

English: Airports nationwide were placed on high alert with intensified screenings following a classified security memo.
Ekegusii: Ebitii biechindeke Kenya engima mbiabiaboretigwe koba maiso na komongera buya baria bonsi bagosoa ase ebitii ebio korengana nogokurerwa kwa ime kwarwetwe nabarendi boborendi.

English: Authorities deployed surveillance, roadblocks, and emergency teams to ensure safety ahead of the Safari Rally.
Ekegusii: Abarendi mbagegete obomongeri, ebitumo ase chipara, na baria bagokonya ekero kiemebasekano goikerania oborendi nyuma yamashindano yechigari.

English: Government issued updates on North Rift anti-banditry operations, including arrests and livestock recovery, urging public cooperation.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yamanyetie abanto ba North Rift igoro yemeroberio yaye gotanga oboibi bwechiombe, abaibi babwatirwe nechiombe chianyorirwe na koiranigwa, na gosaba nga okobwaterana kobeo.

English: Ministry of Interior advised evacuations in conflict-prone and flood-affected areas and deployed emergency response teams.
Ekegusii: Eminisirtiri yoborendi bwaime yarwete ogosemia abanto barwe chngongo chiria neminano na chiria chigoterema amache na gotoma baria bagokonya elero kiemebasekano.

English: NPS reiterated guidance for officers to use proportional force during protests and to prioritize peaceful engagement.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kiabasikari (NPS) kiairoreire komanyia abasikari gotumia chinguru chinke chingaki chiokorobererekana na koba nobwororo chingaki bakoiranererania nabainchi.

English: A national alert was issued over rising insecurity, with assurances that security measures were being strengthened across affected counties.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa Kenya engima nkwarwetwe igoro yoborendi, na koenekeria abanainchi ng'a oborendi boisaine bwabekirwe chikaonti chionsi.

English: U.S. Embassy renewed its advisory on possible unrest during U.S. primaries and urged heightened vigilance in demonstration-prone areas.
Ekegusii: Obobalosi bwa America (U.S. Embassy) aiga Kenya naende yarure ogokurerwa igoro yechiburaburu chingaki chiobochori bwa abarai bwebiam aaria America no kobeka obokongori bwa igoro kegima ase akageire koba nechiburaburu.

English: Authorities issued detailed Cyclone Hidaya safety guidance urging coastal residents to secure property and avoid non-essential travel.
Ekegusii: Abari mbwaretwe oborai boisaine igoro yomorindo okorokwa (Cyclone Hidaya) sna gosaba amenyi bonsi bamenyete ang'e na nyancha barende chinibo chiabo na gokeania chisafari chitari chiengencho.

English: Security agencies increased nationwide patrols during the festive season to deter crime and safeguard communities.
Ekegusii: Abatenereri boborendi bagesire obomongeri bwabo Kenya engima chingaki chiotimoko nemeyega ao ao gotanga obokebago eri korenda ebinyoro.

English: Interior CS briefed the Senate on national security readiness, highlighting anti-terror efforts and enhanced intelligence coordination.
Ekegusii: Omominisita bwoborendi bwa ime narwete enkwana gochia abagambi beseneti buna beariganirie igoro yoborendi bwense, na kobeka chinguru buna okwearigania kwa beene nabasikari baria batenenerete obokebago bwogoaka chipomu beariganirie goetera okoererania kwobotuki.

English: Government reaffirmed its commitment to combating cattle rustling through intensified patrols in the North Rift.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yaenekirie okwerwa kwaye gokora oboibi bwechiombe goetra obomongeria bwaye ase chipara nechinchera ase abaibi bagoetia chiombe chioboibi aaria ensemo ya North Rift.

English: Authorities notified the public of an Al-Shabaab attack in Garissa and urged vigilance as additional troops were deployed.
Ekegusii: Aabarai banyirie abanainchi igoro yobkebago bwogokwa epomu na Al-Shabaab aaria garisa Garissa na gosaba koba maiso buna enchera eyemo gokonya ebikosi bia abasikari biria biatomirwe.

English: NPS discredited multiple fake posters circulating online and urged the public to avoid sharing unverified content.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abasikari (NPS)nkiangete ebinto birikire bia gosiarerwa goetera entaneti buna ebioborimo na gosaba banainchi berende kobisiarera.

English: APS promptly evacuated a school following a bomb threat and initiated investigations while strengthening safety protocols.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) nkinganyetie abanto bwango gotanyorwa korwa esukuru nyuma yogosarera kwamang'ana kwogoakwa epombu na goansa obotuki ekero boigo bagesete oborendi.

English: PRWG urged police to prevent masked infiltrators during protests, maintain professional crowd control, and ensure accountability for misconduct.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete oboonchoreria ase abasikari (PRWG) ngiasororete abasikari gotanga bonsi baria bagwesoi ase okorobererekana koburukania okorobererekana kwomorembe, goikerania amachiko emeremo yabo ekero bakorwa oborendi ase abakorobererekana, na koba ange gotenenera ebokoro biabo.

English: Amnesty Kenya reminded officers to respect protest rights, protect medics and journalists, and avoid excessive force.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Amnesty aiga Kenya nkiainyoretie abasikari gosika amchiko yokorobererekana, barendi abanyagitari nabariki amang'ana, na korenda gotatumia chinguru chinyinge ekero batenenerete okorobererekana.

English: IPOA opened a comprehensive investigation into allegations of police misconduct during June protests, including use of live rounds and mass detentions.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo yabo (IPOA) nkiagorete obotuki obonene komanya igoro yokwemuranganania ng'a abasikari mbakorete meremo yabo buya chingaki chiokorobererekana kwomotienyi 6, amo nogotumia chimbunde bobe na kobeka abanto ase egesibo getari kiaboronge.

English: PRWG reaffirmed that peaceful protests must be protected and criticized failures to separate violent actors from lawful demonstrators.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete oboonchoria ase emeremo yabasikari (PRWG) nkiaenegetie ng''a okorobererekana kwomorembe goika korendwe naigo goteba ng'a abasikari mbasinyetwe goseberania abarobererekani bari bare notindi erio korwa ribaga ase abaroberekani bekeene.

English: Human Rights Watch noted lack of prosecutions for 2023 protest-related deaths and urged enforcement of IPOA recommendations.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria kerigeretie oboronge bwekemwanyabanto (Human Rights Watch) nkiaroche ng'a ogotasoera baria bausikanete namakweri yabaria bakwete ekero okorobererekana kwomwaka 2023 na gosaba ng'a amangana yekeombe keria getenerete obokori emeremo na abasikari (IPOA) yatebete akore emeremo.

English: Investigations revealed police attempts to misreport protest fatalities as accidents, raising concerns over deliberate cover-ups.
Ekegusii: Obotuki mbwaorogetie buna abasikari batemete kobisa enamba yabanto baumiete gose gosiria obogima goetera goetera okorobererekana, buna ringana riamakusudi kobisa amang'ana.

English: Reports detailed police-ordered lockdowns on Saba Saba Day, including blocked routes, live fire, and escalated confrontations.
Ekegusii: Chiripoti igoro ya buna abasikari batangete ogotara, gosanga na koererania amangana rituko ria Saba Saba, goetra ogosieka chipara, okorasa chimbunde, na kogesa emeburukano.

English: Opposition leaders demanded the president’s resignation after he appeared to endorse shoot-on-sight rhetoric during protests.
Ekegusii: Abarai bopinsani mbaimokererete igoro koboria omorai bwense erusie emeremo ekero aitabete ng'a abanto bagosangerekana baraswe amagogoro abwo abwo buna enchera yokobeka asikari chinguri chiogogokorera bobe baria bakorobererekana.

English: Reuters reported the arrest of activist Mwangi over alleged possession of tear gas and ammunition during protests, widely condemned as political intimidation.
Ekegusii: Abamanyi amangana ba Reuters mbamanyetie ense igoro yomoegereri Mwangi ase okomebekerera ng'a nabwate ebinto biria bikoraswa korwa erioki amo nechimbunde chingaki chikoroberekana, na kwanga okogoserigwa konga buna okwo kwegesiasa kwoboi abakoroberekana.

English: The Guardian covered the arrest of a constable linked to a political blogger’s death in custody, seen as a rare step toward accountability.
Ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana ba The Guardian mbarigete igoro yokobwatwa kwomosikari oyio otumegete gesiasa na komobwata kwomoriki amangana bwetenenerete oyio okerete eseri ya polisi buna enchera eyemo ekworokia buna abasikari babweneret goajibika.

English: AP News reported police use of tear gas on activists protesting a custodial death, reigniting public demands for justice and transparency.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana amayia yabasikari boborai (AP) namanyetie buna abasikari barasete ebinto biraia bigokrwa erioki ase gochia ase abaegereri baria bare koroberekana ogori yomoegereri gokwera eseri ya porisi, na gosegeta abanainchi godai ekeene na obomaiso marore ase ayio.

English: Reuters confirmed the arrest of Constable Mukhwana over the death of blogger Albert Ojwang, marking a rare formal charge amid unrest.
Ekegusii: Abarimi amang'ana ba Reuters mbaenegetie okobwatwa kwomosikari Mukhwana igoro yamakweri yomoriki amangana bwogwetenenera Albert Ojwang, eke nigo kiabete egento getanyagokoreka rinde, na konyorwa nare nekina giokoiraneria nonya chuburaburu chiareo.

English: The Guardian reported Constable James Mukhwana as the first officer arraigned over the custodial death case, signaling increased scrutiny of police conduct.
Ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana ba The Guardian mbamanyetie nga omosikari James Mukhwana buna omosikari omotangani gosoerwa igoro yomonto gokwera maboko aye ekero are eseri ya porisi, egekoro gekworokia ng'a abasikari mbarigereirie buna bagokora emeremo yabo.

English: Missing Voices documented a sharp rise in enforced disappearances and killings linked to protests, urging justice for families of missing victims.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Missing Voices mbarigete igoro yokomenteka kwabanto gosira gose gokenganigwa, and goitwa ase engencho yokorobererekana kwanga oborai obobe, na gosaba ng'a ekeeneo gekoreke ase abanto bakenganirie gose kobiswa ase engencho yokorobererekana.

English: AP News covered Mwangi’s release on bail and rights groups’ criticism of terrorism charge misuse during protests.
Ekegusii: Managana amayia yabasikari boborai (AP) nyarigete igoo yokobwatokwa kwa Mwangi ase ogotenenerwa nebiombe biokoegerera ebio biangete okobekererwa kwobosaria bwobokegago bwokoruta chipomu ekero bakorobererekana.

English: Local media reported calls for prosecution of officers accused of excessive force during Gen Z protests, urging IPOA and ODPP action.
Ekegusii: Chisiteseni chai aiga inka chiokomnyia amang'ana nchiatebete konyora chisimi chikogosereri kobabwata na kopbasoera ase ogotangasa abasikari baria basoeretwe gotumia chinguru goetania ekero giokorobererekana chingaki chia Gen Z, na bakarigia ogokonya korwa IPOA na ODPP.

English: An academic analysis linked protest-related abuses to systemic police impunity rooted in historical failures of accountability.
Ekegusii: Amasomo yokongori igoro yabasikari kobuna amahiko ekero giokorobererekana kobwataine nagotakorerwa ekero kwamochire ase obokoreri bwabasikari bwairire emeri ase eiaka emenge yogotakorerwa kende ekero bamochire.

English: A quantitative summary outlined protest timelines, injuries, deaths, arrests, and legislative outcomes to contextualize state response.
Ekegusii: Amangana amanene arikire ase obwenge naorogetie chinsa, buna abanto baumiete, abkwete, ababwatetwe, na ekere kiabete kworokereria buna eserikari egokora emeremo yaye.

English: An encyclopedic overview documented causes, fatalities, economic triggers, and arrest numbers from the 2025 protests.
Ekegusii: Amangana ase oboamo arigetwe naorogetie ekiaretete, omkoumia kwabanto, okomigwa kiuchumi kebogoko buna egesegeto, na enamba ya baria babwatetwe ekero giokoroberereka kwa 2025.

English: Missing Voices published a registry of killings and disappearances among youth during Gen Z protests, calling for formal investigations.
Ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana ba Missing Voices mbarigete buna abasae bare goitwa, gokenganigwa gose kobiswa ekero giokorobererekana kwa Gen Z, na koboria ng'a obotuki bwakeene bokorwe.

English: A civic observance commemorated Saba Saba protest victims, spotlighting grievances over unresolved police brutality cases.
Ekegusii: Rituko riokoinyoro ogokwa kwa baria bare korobererekana ria Saba Saba, mabaorogotie ogotaisaneka igoro yobororo bwamanag'ana atarakwanerwa neserikari igoro buna abasikari batari gokora emeremo yabo koreng'ana namachiko ase abakorobererekana.

English: AP featured families of protest victims expressing grief, frustration with impunity, and demands for justice and oversight reforms.
Ekegusii: Abasikari boborai (AP)mbaorogetie buna chifamiri chia baria barenge ase emechando yogosiria abamwabo, na buna abasikari bakobuna amachiko batari okorerwa kende, na gosaba nga ekeene gekoreke na ogoonchoreria kwa amachiko arengete obokoreri bwa abasikari.

English: BBC aired evidence of coordinated brutality during Gen Z protests, identifying officers and urging prosecution of responsible commanders.
Ekegusii: Abamanyi amang'ana ba BBC mbagegete ase embeo obosaiti buna abasikari bare korasa abanto, gotumi chinguru goetania ekero giokorobererekana kwa abasae Gen Z, goteba abasikari bare gokora ayio na gosaba ng'a abanene ba abasikari baria bare korwa amachiko ng'a barase abanto basoerwe.

English: United Nations urged Kenya to respect human rights during protests and called for independent investigations into killings and disappearances.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwense (UN) mbwasabete Kenya gosika oboronge bwamwanyanto chingaki chiokorobererekana naboigo kobori ng'a obotuki bwetenererete bokorwe igoro yogoitwa kwabanto na gosira kwa abanto batamanyiri ase bare.

English: U.S. Embassy warned citizens of risks during ongoing protests, advising avoidance of demonstration areas due to potential violence.
Ekegusii: Obobarosi bwa america aiga Kenya (U.S. Embassy) mbakurerete abakenya kwerenda chingaki okorobererekana kwagendererete, na korwa ogosemia abanto gotaika ang'e ase okorobererekana kore ase obwoba bwobotindi boreo.

English: Media oversight body condemned arrests and assaults on journalists covering protests, calling for an independent inquiry into press violations.
Ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana ba Media oversight body mbatebete koba bobe okobwatwa na ogoakwa kwabariki amang'ana bare korika na kobwata buna okorobererekana kware gokorwa, na koboria nga obokongori bwabeene bokorwe komnya ninki kiagerete abariki amanga bare gosaganerwa.

English: Katiba Institute reported constitutional rights violations during protests and urged judicial safeguards and rights-based policing.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Katiba Institute nkiamanyetie buna okobunwa kwa amachiko nabasikari kware gokorwa kwegosa gotaiyo chingaki chiokorobererekana na gosaba bororo ng'a amachiko atumeke korenda abakorobererekana buna oboronge bwabo.

English: JLTM NGO documented over 500 protest-related arrests, urging release of minors and access to legal representation.
Ekegusii: JLTM NGO mbarigete goetania abanto500 abarobererekani babwatetwe, na kobori ng'a babwatokwe ara rimo na mono abana abake na baegwe oborongo bwokoegererwa kemachiko.

English: Kenya Red Cross provided data on protest-related injuries and EMS response, urging improved pre-positioning of medical resources.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiomoslaba omobaririri nkiarwete enamba ya baria baumiete ekero giokorobererekana na buna abanyagitari bemebasekano gokonya (EMS), na gosaba ng'a okobwekwa kwebinto biobonyagitari chinsemo chionsi chiokorobererekana bibeo.

English: Law Society demanded accountability for commanders behind protest suppression tactics, calling for prosecutions including chain-of-command responsibility.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia amachiko (Law Society) nkiaboretie ng'a abanene babasikari baria bare korwa amachiko chingaki chiokorobererekana babogorerigwe ebitambokero, na gosaba ng'a abanene babasikari amo na baria baete richiko kobuna amachiko basoerwe.

English: A youth movement organized a peaceful march demanding justice for protest victims and reforms to use-of-force protocols.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwa'basae mwatwarete okorobererekana kwomorembe omotienyi 3 koboria ekeene igoro ya baria baumisetwe nabasikari amo nogoonchoreria kwamachiko igoro yekerengo giechinguru abasikari babwenerete gotumia.

English: Young influencers produced real-time video series documenting protest injuries and brutality to raise awareness and counter state narratives.
Ekegusii: Abasae abasegeti amaonchorerio mbarosetie esinema yechingaki chiokorobererekana na kworokia buna abarobererekani baumiete, na buna abasikari bare gotumia richiko goetania erio komanyia abanto buna enchera eyemo yokworokereria buna eserikari egotumia amachiko bobe.

English: Civil society coalitions opened legal clinics offering free representation to families of protest casualties and detainees.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwa (Civil society Coalitions) mbaigorete ebituo bikorwa obokonyi bwakemachiko bosa goetera kobatenere abarobererekani kotini buna abanogeri babo rase abamwabo baria basiretie abamwabo gose koumia na baria babegetwe echera gotaiwa kotini.

English: Civil society organized silent vigils in Nairobi to honor protest victims and call for justice across diverse communities.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwobomo bwebiombe bitari bieserikari okaroberia ogekengano aaria Nairobi koinyora baria baria bakwete na gokorerwa bobe na koboria ng'a ekeene ase abarobererekani gokoreke ase abanto bonsi Kenya engima.

English: A civic-tech initiative published live maps of protest zones, police deployments, and safe routes to enhance demonstrator safety.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogotumia eintaneti oansirwe okworokia aase okorobererekana kware gokoreka Kenya engima, buna abasikari batometwe, nechinchera chiokominchoreria ase ogokonya abarobererekani.

English: An exhibition showcased photographic evidence of protest brutality and mass gatherings, documenting state response to civic unrest.
Ekegusii: Chipicha chianantetigwe kera aase nchiaenegetie buna abasikari bare gotumia chinguru goetania ase bria bare korobererekana na baria bare konyorwa amo ase obonge, nchiarogetie buna eserikari yaineretie igoro yokogechigwa kwa abainainchi ase obogambi obobe.

English: A rights group compiled a verified injury registry with photos and medical data to support accountability and prosecution efforts.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kioboronge nkiabegete amo eripoti engikeranu igoro ya baria baumiete amo nechibicha neripoti ya nyagitari yabwate amarieta baria baumiete gosira emeroberio yokobabogoreria egatambokero na kobasoera.

English: Workshops trained young journalists in ethical verification, safe documentation, and protective practices during protest reporting.
Ekegusii: Abariki amangana mbasometigigwe buna bakomanya oboikeranu bwamangana, korenda obobisi bwa baria bonsi bausikanete, na buna bakwerenda chingaki bare ase emeremo yabo yokorika amangana ekero giokorobererekana.

English: Community leaders in Garissa received training on early radicalization indicators and reporting procedures under PCVE programs.
Ekegusii: Abarai bebinyoro aaria Garissa mbanyorete amasomo agenkio buna baranyare korora na komanya ebokoro biogosarigwa ebirengererio na engencho yokomanyia abasikari inse yemeroberio yobokoreri bori botenererete gotanga and korwania okwegena gose ebikoro biomonto gose abanto kwegena gotumia obosareku goikera amaganio abo (PCVE).

English: An MoU was signed to integrate gender equality into national PCVE structures and empower women in terrorism-prevention roles.
Ekegusii: Okoigwanana nkwabegetwe egechara kobwatana amo oboreng'ananu bwabanto gochia ase omoroberio bweserikari bwogotanga na korwania obokegab bwogogosria ebirengererio (PCVE) gosomia na na kobaa ebire bineirie erio babe abakoreri bengencho gotanga komanya na gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu.

English: KDF and NCTC held a community engagement initiative in Lamu to build resilience against extremism and inter-communal tension.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kioborendi bwa Kenya (KDF) na Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC)mbabete nomoroberio nokoumerana nebionyoro aaria Lamu erio gikinana nogosarigwa ebirengererio na neminano yebinyoro.

English: Government sought public input on leveraging AI and technology to detect and prevent self-radicalization trends.
Ekegusii: Eserikari nyarigetie ebirengererio korua isiko buna eranyare koreng'anania chisemi chia pandia (AI) na tekinorochia erio komanya na gotanga chinchera abasae bagwesaria ebirengererio barabwo abanyene goetera eintaneti.

English: Government sought public input on using artificial intelligence and new technologies to strengthen prevention of violent extremism and address rising online recruitment risks.
Ekegusii: Eserikari nyarigetie amaoni korwa abanainchi igoro yogotumia akiri pandia na tekinorochia enyia gokongia gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu na gokwanera igoro yemechando yogosoigwa goetera eintaneti.

English: Training provided to mining sector stakeholders on safe handling of commercial explosives to reduce misuse by terror groups and prevent smuggling.
Ekegusii: Ekwegerigwa kwarurwe ase baria bakorema amadini  na baria bakobwaterana buna bakoiya, kogacha na kobibogoria bakeanie okobitatumia buya na baria abasaria bokoruta chipomu na gotanga oboibi bwebinto ebio.

English: Pilot sub county forum launched to build community trust and improve public reporting as part of the national countering violent extremism strategy.
Ekegusii: Emesangerekano ase chikaonti inke yakoretwe korenta obwegenwa ase abanainchi na gokong'ia emeroberio ya abaninchi korwa chiripoti buna ensemo yemoroberio yeserikari gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu.

English: Expanded training in Kiambu brought together county officials, youth, media, and civil society to strengthen local prevention networks.
Ekegusii: Okogareigwa kwamasomo aaria Kiambu nkwaretete amo barai bechikaonti, abasae, abariki amang'ana, amo nebiombe bitari bweserikari (NGOs) samo gokong'ia oborai bwebinyoro gotanga obokebago.

English: Public invited to contribute to development of artificial intelligence tools for detecting self radicalization and improving prevention strategies.
Ekegusii: Abanainchi baariganiigwe gochia korosia ebokoreri bi'akiri pandia bikomanyia omonto buna asriigwe eberengererio na komenta chinchera omonto aranyare kwerenda.

English: Kenya and Indonesia held a Nairobi–Mombasa workshop to share community based approaches and draft a memorandum of understanding on PCVE collaboration.
Ekegusii: Kenya na Indonesia mbabete negeikaranso kia Nairobi – Mombasa gosanga buna ebinyoro biranyare korika amang'ana okoigwanana gose kobwatana igoro yogotanga ogosarigwa ebirengererion gwancha obokebago bwogotumia chinguru (PCVE) ase oboamo.

English: Five day regional training focused on disengagement, de radicalization, and reintegration for security personnel across East Africa.
Ekegusii: Amatuko atano yechingongo kwegera igoro yokwerusia gose gotiga amangana ogosaria ebirengererio na koirana gati yabarendi boborendi Kenya, yuganda na Tanzania (Afrika ya Mocha engima).

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre worked with the Ministry of Basic Education to train teachers on identifying and mitigating radicalization risks in schools.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) kegakora emeremo amo neminisitiri yechisemi chioboroso gosomia abarimu buna bakomanya na gotanga obobe bwiogosarigwa ebirengererio chisukuru.

English: One hundred forty eight park officers trained to strengthen early detection of terror related threats around major tourism areas.
Ekegusii: Obaofisa emia eyemo na merongo ene na batana na batato boborendi aaria ase chingiti chiorosana kirorerwa mbasometigwe gokongia obokoreri bwabo buna bakomongera na komanya ebokoru biobokebago bwokoruta chipomu chinsemo chiabo.

English: Youth beneficiaries in Lamu received entrepreneurship kits and awareness training on preventing violent extremism as part of reintegration efforts.
Ekegusii: Abasae aaria Lamu mbasometigwe na koegwa ebinto kobakonya gochaka ebiasra buna enchera eyemo yogotanga ogosarigwa ebirengererio gosoa obokebago bwokoruta chipomu na koiranigwa inka.

English: Media Council of Kenya urged journalists to report violent extremism responsibly with emphasis on fact checking and ethical coverage to avoid amplifying radical narratives.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboriki bwamang'ana ngiasabete abariki amangana korika na komanyia ense igiroro yobokebago bwogosaria ebirengererio ase enchera engikaranu gose yobomaene gokonya gotanga ogosarera kwobosaria bweberengererio.

English: County public forums in Nairobi reviewed the updated National Strategy to Prevent and Counter Violent Extremism focusing on gender, youth, and technology.
Ekegusii: Omosngerekano obonsi aaria Nairobi norigereretie keboyia emeroberio yaye na korwa omoroberio omoyia igoro yogotanga na korwania obokebago bwogosaria ebirengererio kwarengete abanto bechingencho chionsi, na mono abasae na tekinorochi erio gokora obokebago obwo.

English: Community policing campaign in Lamu engaged youth, elders, and security agencies to strengthen early warning and reporting systems.
Ekegusii: Oborendi bwebinyoro aaria Lamu mbabete nechinkwana chiogosegeta abasae, abakwani bebinyoro, neserikari buna bagokong'ia obomongeri komanya bwango ebikoru biobosaria na komanyia abarendi kegima.

English: Journalists from multiple counties trained on responsible reporting of violent extremism to prevent sensationalism and reduce harm.
Ekegusii: Abariki amangana korwa chinse ao ao mbaegeretie igoro yokorika na komanyia goetra amangana ase enchera engikeranu igoro yogosarigwa ebirengererio buna enchera eyemo yogotanga ogosarigwa obongo amangana echinkuma, okogosia gose okongainereria erio gotanga ogosareka kwa'bange.

English: Security Sector Counter Violent Extremism partners held public forums in Mapenya and Mkunumbi to build resilience and counter extremist messaging.
Ekegusii: Ensemo yoborendi ase okobwaterana korwana nobokebago bwogosaria amongo koba ekabago gikoruta chipomu mbagete nechinkwana nabanainchi aaria Mapenya na Mkunumbi kobaa chinguru gotenena na korwania obokebago bwogosaria amongo goetera ogotoma amang'ana ameng'e esimi.

English: Training delivered to Anti Terrorism Police Unit officers to strengthen ideological awareness and operational skills under the national CVE framework.
Ekegusii: Amasomo arwetwe ase abasikari bari batenererete gotanga ogwateka gwechipomu gokongia chinhera chikomanya ebirengererio biogosari obongo na buna oranyare gotanga ayio goetera amachiko yokorwania gotanga gosarigwa obongo.

English: County security engagement forums enhanced collaboration between communities and security agencies for early warning in high risk areas of Lamu.
Ekegusii: Okobwaterana ase aborendi bechikaonti ngwakongetie oboererania gati yebinyoro nabarendi boborendi komanya bwango ebiorokererio bwobokebago bwokoruta chipomu chinsemo chiria chiregire nobokebago aaria Lamu.

English: Advisory notes high likelihood of terrorist attacks targeting public areas and urges awareness and adherence to security guidance.
Ekegusii: Abasemia baorokirie okonyarekana goakwa chipomu chirengete aba abanto bare na igo gosaba abanto komanyigwa berende na kobwatia amachiko oborendi.

English: United States advisory urges increased caution due to terrorism and kidnapping risks and recommends reviewing personal security plans.
Ekegusii: Abasemia ba America koba maisi enchera ya igoro mono igoro igoro yobokebago nokobwatwa na gotamigwa kwa'banto na gosaba nga amachiko oborendi arigererigwe keboyia.

English: Counties along the Somalia border face heightened terrorism threats and essential travel only is advised.
Ekegusii: Chikaonti chiruia chibebekanete na Somalia chire ase obwoba bogoakwa chipomu ase igo gababwa ng'a bkeanie chisafari chiabo.

English: Security tightened in Lamu following recent attacks and travelers are urged to remain vigilant and avoid certain road routes.
Ekegusii: Oborendi bwabekirwe boisaine aaria Lamu ase engencho yogoakwa chipomu bwango iga, ase ayio na abanto bare ase chifari chiabo baboriigwe koba maiso ase ogotaetera chinchera chiria chiregire.

English: United Kingdom advisory urges alertness in hotels, malls, and transport hubs and encourages use of counter terrorism guidance.
Ekegusii: Abasemia ba United Kingdom basabire abanyene bechinyoma chiokoragera na korara, chiduka chinene chikoonia ebinto ao ao, amo naase chirori chikorinerwa erio koba maiso na kobwatia amachiko ogotanga obokebago.

English: DusitD2 attack underscores importance of knowing emergency exits and procedures in hotels and office buildings.
Ekegusii: Ogoakwa epomu gwa DusitD2 nogokurera ng'a komanya bwango na gotanga obokebago nechinchera chiokominchoreria nemeroberio yonsi ase chinyomba chiokoragerera nechiofisi eikaranigwe.

English: Advisories recommend avoiding large gatherings and taking caution during religious and cultural events due to elevated risks.
Ekegusii: Obosemia obwo nigo bokomanyia ng'a bonsi baria bare ase emesangerekano yabanto abange buna chikanisa nemesikiti na emesangerekano ende yonsi babe maiso ekiagera yogoakwa chipomu okwo gokageire koba.

English: High threat of kidnapping targeting foreigners in northern and coastal areas and travelers are urged to avoid high risk zones.
Ekegusii: Obwoba bwa igoro bwokobwatwa na kobiswa kwabanto korengete abarwa isiko bamenyete aaria Irianyi mbarabare nenyancha na baria bonsi bagotumia chigari ase rogendo baboriigwe gotaika ange nchinsemo echio chiregire nobokebago.

English: Terrorist attacks are more likely during major holidays and the public is urged to maintain heightened awareness and avoid crowded spaces.
Ekegusii: Ogoakwa chipomu ngokageire mono chingaki chiemetiko nemeyega emenene igo ogosaba goikarania koba maiso kwarurwe goetra okomanyania na kwebacha korwa omoganda bwabanto abange.

English: Government outlines offenses classified as terrorism under the Prevention of Terrorism Act and urges public awareness of legal obligations.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yarure omoroberio ogoatanana igoro yamnamocho yobokebago bwokoruta chipomu inse yamachiko yogotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu na gosaba abanto komanya igoro ya ayare obwenerete gokora aye buna omokenya.

English: Kenya hosts regional training to strengthen capacity in combating terrorism financing with participation from experts across Africa.
Ekegusii: Kenya yaretire amo okwegerigwa kwa abarai bechingongo gokongia okobua kwabo korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu na baria bakorwa chibesa gokora ayio ase ogasanga nabimanyi korwa Afrika engima.

English: Analysis identifies persistent terrorist activity in counties bordering Somalia and urges adherence to safety recommendations.
Ekegusii: Obokongori bwaorokirie igoro yokogenderera kwobkebago bwokuruta chipomu ase chikaonti chiria chibebekaine na Somalia na gosaba ng'a okobwatia amachiko oborendi buna ring'ana riengencho.

English: United Kingdom advisory urges continued vigilance due to unpredictable threats in public places, hotels, and religious sites.
Ekegusii: Obosemia korwa United Kingdom bwasabire omongeri bwakogenderera ase engencho yogotamanyereria ekero ebibago birarute chipomu ase abanto, chinyomba chiokoragera, naase gosabera.

English: National Assembly strengthens laws to detect and prevent terrorism financing and improve transparency across financial systems.
Ekegusii: Bunge yakong'irie laws yokomanya na gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu n baria bakobaa chibesa gokora ayio naboigo koba maiso marore buna chibesa chigoeta anaboko abanto.

English: Kenya and the United Kingdom opened a modern Anti Terrorism Police Unit headquarters in Mombasa to enhance coastal security capacity.
Ekegusii: Kenya amo na United Kingdom Bigoire polisi enyia buna oboikaranso bwaye obonene aaria Mombasa etenerete gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu gokong'ia oborendi boetanaine enyancha.

English: Canada advises high vigilance across Kenya due to ongoing extremist threats and warns against large gatherings.
Ekegusii: Canada yarure obosemia koba maiso Kenya engima ase engencho ykogosia okwo kogendererete jkwogoakwa chipomu na gosaba nga abanto tibaba ase emesagerekano ybanto abange amo.

English: Kenya introduced legislation regulating virtual asset service providers to reduce money laundering and terrorism financing risks.
Ekegusii: Kenya yaansire amachiko goyotanga baria bagotoma chibesa goetera eintaneti bakeanie oborosia bwechibesa pandia gosegeta obokebago ase akobaa chibesa echio.

English: United Nations and Kenyan agencies co hosted workshops to help local officials and communities address incitement and prevent extremism.
Ekegusii: United Nations amo na Kenyan nebitengo biaye mbaraete omosangerekano barai ba inse nebinyoro biabo gotanga obosegeti korwania obokebago bwogosaria obongo.

English: Reports show continued Al Shabaab activity near the Somalia border and call for sustained vigilance.
Ekegusii: Chiripoti nkwrokia chire buna ebikoru bia Al Shabaab ang'e nechimbebe chia Somalia igo koboria koba maiso chingaki chionsi.

English: Parliament is reviewing amendments to strengthen oversight and enforcement against terrorism financing.
Ekegusii: Bunge negendererete korigereria amaonchorerio gokong'ia obomongeria nechinguru igoro yokoa ebibago bwokoruta chibesa.

English: The National Counter Terrorism Centre continues public alerts urging vigilance and reporting of suspicious activity.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkegendererete korwa ogokurerwa na korwa amang'ana igoro yebikoru biechitang'utang'u gochia ase abarai.

English: Kenya and the United Kingdom opened a new Anti Terrorism Police Unit facility in Mombasa to strengthen operations.
Ekegusii: Kenya nobomo bwa Boraya mbaigorete egetuo kiabasikari kegokinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu aaria Mombasa gokongia obokoreri.

English: Critics warn that terrorism related charges applied to protestors must balance security with constitutional rights.
Ekegusii: Abmongeria goro yekeene basiemire eserikari ase ogotumia richiko riobokebago bwokoruta chipomu gosoera abakorobererekana koba mamincha nerichiko kobiga abakorobererekana na mamincha yobosibore bwomonto bwerichiko gotara, gosangererekana na gokwanerana.

English: After the 2015 Garissa University attack, authorities increased security and encouraged vigilance in learning institutions.
Ekegusii: Ekero eyunifasity ya Garissa yasaganetwe nobokebago bwogoakwa epomu, abarai mbagesete oborendi na gosegeta obomongeria ime yechisukuru.

English: The Anti Terrorism Police Unit conducts preparedness training and urges ongoing vigilance.
Ekegusii: Abasikari bensemo yokorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu ngokora bare okwegeria igoro yokoba maiso na gosaba ng'a abanto batigare koba maiso.

English: The National Counter Terrorism Centre calls for prompt reporting of suspicious activities.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene giokorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) kiaboririe nga abanto bagenderere gokenyia ebikoru baroche biechitangutangu.

English: The United Kingdom advises visitors to remain vigilant due to terrorism threats targeting public areas.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwa Boraya (United Kingdom) bwasemirwe abare bakobatarera koba maiso ase engencho yobwoba bwobokebago bwokoruta chipomu borengete ase abanto abange bare.

English: A UN workshop brought together multiple sectors to improve strategies for preventing violent extremism.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwechinse (UN) mbwaretete amo abanto ao ao korwa eserikari goikerania emeroberio yogotanga obokebago bwogosaria abanto amongo goetera amorokererio amabe.

English: Advisories highlight persistent al Shabaab threats and urge high situational awareness.
Ekegusii: Abasemia bamanyirie igoro yokonyarekana kwa al Shabaab kogenderera koruta chipomu na gosaba ng'a abanto babe maiso komanya eki barengete.

English: A terrorism threat report outlines activity by al Shabaab and IS and stresses public vigilance.
Ekegusii: Erpoti yobokebago igoro yokoruta chipomu yaorogetie ebokoru bia al Shabaab amo nobomo bwaisabanto batigare maiso.

English: The United Kingdom warns of high terrorism risk in Kenya, especially targeting UK interests.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwa Boraya (United Kingdom) bwarure ogokurera igoro yokonyarekana goakwa nebibago bwokoruta chipomu aiga nka Kenya, mono kegima birengete abanto bense yabo abwo bare iaga Kenya nebinto biabo.

English: Authorities warn that extremists may continue targeting critical infrastructure.
Ekegusii: Aborai bwarure ogokurerwa ng'a ebibago biogosaria abanto amongo mbirengete goaka ebikoreri ao ao bioborendi biserikari.

English: An annual analysis reviews terrorism trends and advises residents and travelers on safety.
Ekegusii: Okorigereria gwa kera omwaka bunayeboba bikoruta chipomu gwasemirie abamenyi na baria bakogenda chisafari berende.

English: Summary of tactics used in Westgate, Garissa, and Dusit attacks with government guidance on reporting, preparedness, and emergency response.
Ekegusii: Obwenge bwa'mangana igoro yechinchera chiatumegete goaka chipomu aaria Westgate, Garissa, na Dusit eserikari yarwete oborai buna abariki amang'ana na komanyia amangana ayio abanto yakoretwe, koba maiso, na ekere kiare gokorwa chingaki echio chiemebasekano.

English: Advisory highlighting increased terrorism threats in the United States and urging vigilance and reporting of suspicious activities.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa korwa eserikari kwamanyirie abanto igoro yokogeseka kwobokebago bwokoruta chipomu aaria America na koboria ng'a babe maiso na komanyia ase obwango gento kende gionsi bare nechitang'utang'u nakerokio.

English: National campaign encouraging the public to report suspicious activity to prevent terrorism related crimes.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio omone bwense ogosegeta abanto komanyia eserikari bokoru binde bionse biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwonsi bwokoruta chipomu.

English: Message encouraging citizens to recognize and report suspicious behavior noting that vigilance strengthens community security.
Ekegusii: Amangana amenge esimi koa abanainchi emioyo buna bakomanya na korwa eripot igoro yebikoru biechitangutangu bamanyete buya ng'a koba maiso nenchera eyemo yogokongia oborendi bwebinyoro.

English: Advisory urging reporting of suspicious activity in public spaces such as schools, concerts, and sporting events.
Ekegusii: Ogokurera korwa eserikari korigetie abanto korwa amang'ana gochia agambi igoro yebikoru biechitang'utang'u aase abanto bakobera buna chisukuru, chinyomba chiokwegokeria, amo nechogosori.

English: Outline of four steps to enhance digital safety and strengthen national security online.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwebinto bine ebikeranu gokong'ia oborendi bwedichitari na gokong'ia oborendi bwense ase eintaneti.

English: Assessment noting high terrorism threat levels in the United States from domestic and foreign violent extremists.
Ekegusii: Okorenga kwa beene nkwaorogetie ase ebirengo bia igoro ng'a okonyarekana kwogoakwa chipomu aaria America korwa ebibago bia ime na korwa isiko.

English: Overview of updated United Kingdom counter terrorism laws including youth diversion and enhanced risk management tools.
